options.c: Архитектура без бизнес-целей не стратегия.

options.t: I'd copy the strategy of a successful tech company and adapt it.
options.c: Чужая стратегия не отвечает на ваши ограничения.

words.how: План развития технологий компании в связке с бизнесом.
words.ex: The technology strategy has three pillars.

words.how: Главный показатель, на который работает вся команда.
words.ex: Our north star metric is deploy frequency.

words.how: Способ ставить цели с измеримыми результатами.
words.ex: Each pillar has its own OKR.

steps.msg: The company is considering buying a small startup for its technology. Ava asks you to do technical due diligence in one week.

options.t: In a week I can check four things: code quality and tests, security, key people, and fit with our stack. I'll give a red, yellow, green view for each, not a full audit, and list what we couldn't check.
options.c: Честно ограничивает объём недели и показывает, чего проверить не удалось.

options.t: I'd run a full audit with an external firm, which takes about two months.
options.c: Месяцы не вписываются в срок и стоят дорого.

options.t: I'd talk to their CTO and decide from that conversation.
options.c: Мнение о себе от CTO стартапа — не проверка.

options.t: I'd check only the code and send you a score.
options.c: Код — часть картины: люди, безопасность и совместимость тоже важны.

words.how: Покупка компании в первую очередь ради её специалистов.
Риск, что купленную технологию трудно встроить.

steps.msg: Sofia reports that an attacker may have accessed a database with customer emails. She is not sure yet. The legal team asks whether to tell customers now.

options.t: Let's not guess. We confirm what was accessed within 24 hours. Legal prepares two notices, and we send the right one as soon as the facts are clear, within the legal limit.
options.c: Сначала факты за 24 часа, готовые тексты и отправка в законный срок.

options.t: Tell customers now that data may have been stolen, to be safe.
options.c: Сообщение до фактов может напугать без причины и позже окажется неверным.

options.t: Wait until we are fully sure, even if it takes a week.
options.c: Неделя без уведомления нарушает законные сроки.

options.t: Don't tell anyone unless we have proof of data theft.
options.c: Скрывать возможную утечку — юридический и репутационный риск.

words.ex: We may have a data breach.
Forensics will tell us what was accessed.
Breach notification has a seventy two hour limit.

steps.msg: A three-hour outage hit customers. Support wants a public status post. Marketing says: 'Don't use the word outage.' You must approve the text.

options.t: 'We had an outage from 14:00 to 17:00. Orders were not processed. It is fixed. We are sorry. Here is what we are changing.' Plain words, no spin.
options.c: Время, последствия, извинение и меры — простыми словами.

options.t: 'We experienced a brief service disruption. We are working to improve.'
options.c: «Brief» неправда: три часа не «краткий».

options.t: 'Some customers may have noticed slower performance. All is well now.'
options.c: Преуменьшение разрушает доверие, когда клиенты вспомнят потерянные заказы.

options.t: No public post. Let's contact the big customers directly.
options.c: Только крупным клиентам: остальные узнают из соцсетей.

words.ex: Post the update on the status page.

words.how: Подача фактов так, чтобы скрыть проблему.
words.ex: Avoid spin in an incident post.

words.how: Скидка клиентам за нарушение гарантий доступности.
words.ex: We offer an SLA credit to enterprise customers.

steps.msg: Elena says engineers have stopped reporting small mistakes, because last quarter two people were blamed in a review. She asks how you will fix this.

options.t: I'll say openly at the all-hands that mistakes reported early are praised and hidden ones are the problem. I'll also thank the next person who reports one in public, and we'll rewrite the review template to remove blame.
options.c: Публичный сигнал, личный пример и изменение документа: культура меняется действиями.

options.t: I'll send an email reminding everyone to report all mistakes.
options.c: Письмо не отменяет опыт, когда людей наказали.

options.t: I'll create an anonymous form for reporting mistakes.
options.c: Анонимность закрывает симптом, но не восстанавливает доверие.

options.t: I'll ask the managers to be more careful in reviews.
options.c: Размытое «быть осторожнее» ничего не меняет в шаблонах и реакции.

words.how: Уверенность, что можно признавать ошибки без наказания.
Событие, которое могло привести к сбою, но не привело.

steps.msg: Ava wants to launch a feature that uses AI. Your team could build it in nine months, or you could partner with a vendor and launch in two. The vendor would see some customer data.

options.t: I'd partner for the first version with strict data limits and a clause that bans training models on our data. In parallel, we learn from it, and decide in a year whether to build our own.
options.c: Быстрый запуск, ограничения на данные и пересмотр решения через год.

options.t: I'd build it. Customer data must never leave the company.
options.c: Девять месяцев — риск упустить рынок, а запрет «никогда» не гибок.

options.t: I'd partner and give the vendor full access, to get the best results.
options.c: Полный доступ к данным создаёт юридический и репутационный риск.

options.t: I'd wait for the technology to mature before doing anything.
options.c: Ожидание отдаёт рынок конкурентам.

words.how: Договор о том, как поставщик может использовать данные клиента.
words.ex: Sign a data processing agreement first.
Ban model training on our data.

words.how: То, что компания должна уметь лучше всех.
words.ex: AI isn't our core competence yet.

steps.msg: The company grew from 40 to 120 engineers. Decisions are slow because everything goes through you. Elena asks what you will change.

options.t: I'll define which decisions are mine and which are for directors. Directors get clear limits and a monthly review. I step out of everything below those limits, and I stop attending their design reviews.
options.c: Границы решений, правила пересмотра и реальный отход: делегирование без потери контроля.

options.t: I'll hire an assistant to filter what reaches me.
options.c: Ассистент не меняет, кто принимает решения.

options.t: I'll work longer hours until the team is bigger.
options.c: Переработка не масштабируется на 120 человек.

options.t: I'll ask people to bring me only the important decisions.
options.c: «Важное» без критериев каждый понимает по-своему.

words.ex: My span of control is too wide.

words.how: Кто имеет право решать какие вопросы.

words.ex: Assign a DRI for each project.

steps.msg: Ava asks: 'If you left tomorrow, who could run engineering?' You have no clear answer.

options.t: Honestly, nobody fully. I'd name two directors as candidates, set a 12-month plan for each, and bring you progress every quarter.
options.c: Честный ответ, два кандидата и план: это работа CTO.

options.t: I'm irreplaceable. The team can't run without me for a month.
options.c: Незаменимость — признак слабой системы, а не силы.

options.t: Any of the directors could do it. They are all strong.
options.c: Общая оценка без разбора: у каждого свои пробелы.

options.t: I'd rather not discuss this. I'm not planning to leave.
options.c: Избегание вопроса снижает доверие CEO.

words.how: Сколько людей готовы занять ключевые роли.

words.ex: A stretch role develops a candidate.

steps.msg: Ava asks you to cut testing time before a major launch, to 'save a week.' You see a high risk of defects in the payments flow.

options.t: I can save four days by cutting low-risk areas, like admin screens. I won't cut payment testing. If a payment bug reaches customers, it costs more than a week.
options.c: Экономит там, где риск мал, и держит линию на критичном; цена ошибки названа.

options.t: I'll cut a week of testing everywhere, but I want your written approval.
options.c: Бумажное одобрение не защитит клиентов от ошибок в платежах.

options.t: I'll cut testing, and we'll fix any bugs after the launch.
options.c: Баги в продакшене стоят дороже, а оплата — самое чувствительное место.

options.t: I won't cut anything. Testing time is not negotiable.
options.c: Абсолютный отказ без альтернативы: CEO ищет путь, а не стену.

words.how: Тесты, которые проверяют, что старое не сломалось.
Больше тестов там, где ошибка стоит дороже.
Момент, когда система начинает работать у клиентов.

steps.msg: Ava publicly announces a launch date to customers without asking you. Your team says it cannot be met. She is proud of the announcement.

options.t: I'd talk to Ava privately today: "I want to make this date work. Here is what is realistic, and here is what I need from you." Then agree on how we communicate any change.
options.c: Личный разговор, цель, ясные условия.

options.t: I'd raise it with Ava in the leadership meeting, so that everyone hears the same facts about the risk and we decide together.
options.c: Публично, и Ава может почувствовать нападение.

options.t: I'd ask the team to try to make the date. It's the CEO's promise, and we should help her keep her word.
options.c: Рискует командой ради лояльности.

options.t: I'd tell the team: "It's the CEO's date, and it's not my fault if it's not realistic." The CEO set the date without asking us. The team should know that I was not part of that decision.
options.c: Дистанцируется и подрывает команду.

words.ex: Let's align before we speak to customers.

steps.msg: In the private conversation Ava says: "I know, but I can't take it back. Customers are waiting. What can you promise?" You can do a beta on the date, and the full launch four weeks later.

options.t: On the date: a limited beta with core features. Four weeks later: the full launch. You can tell customers "beta on the 15th, full release in October." I'll give a weekly update.
options.c: Даёт реалистичную версию и формулировку.

options.t: I can promise the date for the main flow only. The extra features would follow later, and I'll tell you every week how it goes. Anything more depends on the client. Our designers are busy until the end of the month.
options.c: Идея верная, но без формулировки.

options.t: I'd promise the date again, and ask the team to work extra hours. We have a month to prepare. I'd rather not spend too much time on it.
options.c: Повторяет невыполнимое.

options.t: I can't promise anything now. Let me see how the team progresses, and then I'll tell you what can be done.
options.c: Не помогает Аве выйти из ситуации.

words.how: Ограниченный выпуск продукта для части пользователей.
words.ex: The beta ships on the fifteenth.
A phased launch fits the date.

words.how: Кому, что и когда мы сообщаем.

steps.msg: A journalist calls after the outage and asks you: "Were customer payments lost? Is it true that you had no backup plan?" You are not sure about some details.

options.t: I can confirm: orders were not processed from 14:00 to 17:00, and we have no evidence that payments were lost. I'll check the backup details and send you a written answer by tomorrow.
options.c: Факты, граница знания и срок.

options.t: We are still investigating, and I can't give you more information now. I'll get back to you when we know more.
options.c: Безопасно, но без каких-либо подтверждённых фактов.

options.t: Payments were not lost and we had a backup plan. I'm sure everything worked as designed, and our customers are safe. We can improve it in the next sprint. I will tell the team if something changes.
options.c: Утверждает то, в чём не уверен.

options.t: No comment. Please contact our press office, and they will answer your questions in writing.
options.c: Отказ без пользы, и журналист напишет свою версию.

words.ex: Everything you say is on the record.

words.how: То, что проверено и может быть названо публично.

steps.msg: The next day the article says: "The company admits its backup failed." Your quote was "we are checking backup details." Ava is angry and asks you to publish a rebuttal.

options.t: I'd publish a short correction with facts: what we said, what is true, and what we are checking. No attack on the journalist. I'd also ask them for a note under the article.
options.c: Факты и спокойный тон.

options.t: I'd send an email to the journalist asking to fix the headline, and keep the rest quiet, so that the story doesn't grow.
options.c: Тихий путь, но неточность остаётся.

options.t: I'd write a strong response that calls the article misleading. We should defend the company, and our customers should see that.
options.c: Конфликт привлекает больше внимания.

options.t: I'd ignore it. The story will be forgotten in a few days, and a response will only keep it alive. A reaction would make the story larger.
options.c: Оставляет искажение без ответа.

words.how: Публичный ответ на утверждение, которое считаешь неверным.
words.ex: A short rebuttal is better than a long one.

steps.msg: At 06:10 you get a call: ransomware encrypted part of your production systems. Orders are down. Ava is on the call with the lawyer and the head of security. What is your first action?

options.t: I'd form a small incident team with clear roles, set a call every hour, and isolate the affected systems first. I'd ask the head of security to lead the technical response.
options.c: Структура, изоляция, роли.
options.r: The team forms in ten minutes, and the attack stops spreading.

options.t: I'd ask everyone to start restoring systems from the backups as quickly as possible, so that customers can order again soon. Time is important, and every hour without orders costs money.
options.c: Бросается восстанавливать без изоляции.
options.r: Systems come back, but the same attacker access is still open and they are encrypted again.

options.t: I'd join the technical team and help find the attack path, because I know the systems better than anyone.
options.c: Уходит в детали и оставляет решения без руководителя.
options.r: Nobody leads the response, and the call fills with questions.

options.t: I'd talk to the attacker's contact point and see what they want, so that we have more information before deciding.
options.c: Контакт с атакующим без плана и без юристов.
options.r: The attacker replies with a higher price, and the lawyers are angry.

steps.explain: В начале кризиса важны структура и изоляция: назначьте роли, ограничьте ущерб и только потом восстанавливайте. Контакт с атакующим без плана опасен.

words.how: Группа с ролями для работы с серьёзным сбоем.

steps.msg: By 09:00 you know that backups from the last 48 hours are clean. Customer data may have been copied. The legal team says some laws require notification within 72 hours. Ava asks what to tell customers now.

options.t: Tell them now: systems are down, we are restoring from clean backups, data access is being investigated, and we will update every 4 hours. Do not guess about data until we confirm it.
options.c: Честно, сразу и с ритмом обновлений.
options.r: Customers see the real situation, and many thank you for the honest updates.

options.t: Tell customers we have a technical outage and we're working on it. We'll talk about data later when the facts are clear. The facts are still not clear. I don't want to say something that I must take back later.
options.c: Скрывает природу инцидента.
options.r: Customers are annoyed when they learn the truth in the news at noon.

options.t: Wait until noon. By then we will know more, and we'll send one clear message instead of several.
options.c: Молчание в пик тревоги.
options.r: Customers wait with no information, and support is flooded with calls.

options.t: Don't say anything about data, and don't use the word ransomware. We don't want to scare customers or give attackers more attention.
options.c: Скрытность, которую раскроют журналисты.
options.r: A journalist finds out the truth, and the story becomes about hiding facts.

steps.explain: В кризисе клиентам нужны правда, шаги и ритм обновлений. Не гадайте о данных, но и не прячьте природу инцидента.

words.ex: Regulatory notification is due in seventy two hours.

words.how: Короткое официальное сообщение, пока факты неизвестны.

steps.msg: The attackers demand $2 million and say they will publish the data if you do not pay. Ava looks at you and says: "What do you recommend?"

options.t: Do not pay yet. Restore from backups, work with law enforcement and a specialist firm, and prepare for the data to appear. Paying does not guarantee deletion. This is my recommendation, the decision is yours.
options.c: Рекомендация с причиной и границей решений.
options.r: Ava listens, and the board sees that you advised clearly.

options.t: I'd pay a small part and negotiate, because it gives us time to restore. We can ask the specialists to help with it. The specialists know how to talk with these people.
options.c: Часть выкупа не защищает и подстёгивает.
options.r: The attackers ask for more, and the money is gone.

options.t: I'd leave this to legal and security. It's more about risk and law than about engineering, and I'd like to keep my focus on restoring.
options.c: Уходит от обязанности советовать.
options.r: Ava feels alone with the decision, and she remembers it.

options.t: Pay immediately. The data matters more than the money, and the sooner it's done, the sooner we can go back to normal.
options.c: Не гарантирует итог и поддерживает преступление.
options.r: The files are not deleted, and the data still appears online.

steps.explain: Руководитель должен дать рекомендацию, оставив решение CEO. Выкуп не гарантирует удаления данных; лучше восстановление и привлечение специалистов.

words.ex: Do not pay the ransom demand yet.
This is a case of data extortion.

steps.msg: A week later systems are back. The board asks for a plan for how to avoid this. Your team is exhausted, and two engineers want to quit. Which do you do first?

options.t: First, rest and recognition: two days off for the people who worked nights, and a public thank you. Then a 30-day security plan with owners, so the board sees a clear next step.
options.c: Люди и затем план.
options.r: The team feels cared for, and the board accepts a 30-day plan with owners.

options.t: First, the plan for the board. The board is waiting, and the team will understand. I'll thank them after the presentation.
options.c: Порядок наоборот: усталость растёт.
options.r: The team is angry about delays, and one of the two engineers resigns.

options.t: I'd hire an external security firm to do everything, so that the team can go back to normal work and not worry about security. I will tell the team if something changes. Honestly, that is the simplest option for me.
options.c: Отодвигает команду и не решает усталость.
options.r: The outside firm helps, but the team feels pushed aside.

options.t: I'd ask the two engineers to stay for another quarter, as we need them for the next project and the cost of losing them is high.
options.c: Просит остаться вместо заботы.
options.r: The two engineers stay for a month, and then leave anyway.

steps.explain: После кризиса сначала позаботьтесь о людях, затем дайте совету план. Усталая команда не выполнит ни одного плана.

words.how: Шаги, чтобы вернуть системы и работу.
words.ex: The recovery plan has four phases.
The board wants a security roadmap.
The post-incident review is next week.

endings.good: The company comes out of the crisis stronger. Customers see honesty and speed, your team feels protected, and the board gives you more responsibility.
endings.mid: The company survives, but with damage to trust and a tired team. People will remember how you handled the early hours.
endings.bad: The crisis leaves lasting damage. Customers and key people leave, and you must rebuild trust from zero.

steps.msg: Ava wants to ship a "dark pattern" feature: a hidden option that renews subscriptions automatically and makes cancelling hard. It would increase revenue by 8% this year. She asks for your support.

options.t: I understand the revenue goal. I'm worried that hard cancelling will increase complaints and chargebacks, and it may be illegal in some markets. Can I show you an option that raises revenue without trapping customers?
options.c: Признаёт цель, называет риск и даёт замену.
options.r: Ava listens, and your alternative becomes a test within a week.

options.t: I think it's risky, but if legal confirms that it is allowed, I can support it, and my team will build it.
options.c: Опирается на закон, а не на ценности.
options.r: Legal confirms it is allowed in one market, but complaints rise in a month.

options.t: I'd rather not be part of it. Please ask someone else to lead this feature, and I'll focus on other projects. I'm not comfortable with this project. I have my own tasks that are more important.
options.c: Отходит и оставляет команду без защиты.
options.r: Ava finds another leader, and your team gets less influence.

options.t: Okay, it's your decision. I'll tell the team to build it, and we'll see what the customers say.
options.c: Перекладывает ответственность.
options.r: The feature ships, and the support team is soon full of complaints.

steps.explain: Если просят сделать нечто сомнительное, признайте цель, назовите конкретные риски и предложите лучшую альтернативу. Отказ без замены или молчаливое согласие хуже.

words.how: Интерфейс, который обманом заставляет делать невыгодное.
words.ex: This design is a dark pattern.

words.how: Возврат денег через банк по запросу клиента.

steps.msg: Ava replies: "Competitors do this, and my investors expect growth. I need this." She is under pressure and asks again.

options.t: I hear the pressure. I'll commit to a growth plan: easier upgrade paths and a better trial. If I don't deliver a similar revenue gain in two quarters, we discuss this feature again.
options.c: Берёт обязательство и ставит срок.
options.r: Ava agrees to your plan, and you both set a date to review the numbers.

options.t: Let's do a test with 5% of customers and see the numbers. If complaints rise, we stop. I'm sure it will work out.
options.c: Идея теста, но он всё же вредит клиентам.
options.r: The test shows an increase in revenue, but also in cancellations and complaints.

options.t: I understand, but I really can't support it. This is not what I believe is right for our customers. I would rather say it honestly than hide it.
options.c: Позиция честная, но без пути вперёд.
options.r: Ava feels you left her alone, and the relationship becomes cold.

options.t: Fine. If the investors expect it, we should do it. I'll make sure the implementation is as smooth as possible.
options.c: Уступает давлению.
options.r: The feature ships, and your team sees you gave up your own principles.

steps.explain: Когда давят снова, сочетайте твёрдость с обязательством: предложите альтернативу и срок проверки. Простое «нет» или сдача позиции не решают проблему.

words.ru: переход из пробного периода в платный
words.how: Доля пользователей, которые оплатили после триала.
Доля клиентов, которые уходят за период.

words.ex: I commit to a growth plan.

steps.msg: Weeks later you learn that a product manager shipped a softer version of the hidden renewal without your approval, hoping to please Ava. Your team asks what you will do.

options.t: I'd ask the product manager to remove it today and meet with them privately. In the team meeting I'd say what I expect, and I'd take part of the responsibility for not being clear earlier.
options.c: Исправляет, объясняет ожидания и берёт часть вины.
options.r: The product manager fixes it quickly, and the team sees where the line is.

options.t: I'd tell the product manager to change it in the next release and explain that it's against our values.
options.c: Реакция верная, но срок слишком долгий.
options.r: The change waits for a release, and customers meanwhile see the hidden renewal.

options.t: I'd report it to Ava and let her decide, because she asked for it and it's a business decision. Ava has the power to decide. I'd not like to take such a risk on my own.
options.c: Снимает с себя решение.
options.r: Ava refuses to remove it, and the team sees you did not use your own authority.

options.t: I'd ignore it now. It's already shipped, and a conflict will only damage the team spirit.
options.c: Позволяет нарушению остаться.
options.r: The team learns that values can be skipped, and similar cases start to appear.

steps.explain: Когда ценности нарушены, исправьте немедленно, объясните ожидания и признайте собственную роль. Игнорирование показывает команде, что ценности необязательны.

words.how: Готовность отвечать за результат и решения.
Правила, кто и что утверждает перед релизом.

endings.good: Your choice protects the culture and the business, and the team sees you hold the line when it is hard.
endings.mid: The business gets what it wants, but part of the team starts to doubt what you stand for.
endings.bad: You lose the team's respect and your own comfort, and the business is not much better off.

tone.ctx: After the standup you want to ask Priya for help with the Postgres container, but she is in the middle of a review. Write your message.

opts.t: Whenever you have ten minutes, could you look at the Postgres exit code with me? I already checked the logs and the port.
opts.c: Конкретно, с показанной работой и без давления: Прия сама выберет время.

opts.t: I can't continue until someone fixes this setup guide. Please look at it today.
opts.c: Звучит как требование и перекладывает вину на документацию.

opts.t: Sorry to bother you, I know you're busy, it's probably something stupid, so ignore this if you want.
opts.c: Слишком много извинений и самоуничижения: непонятно, что именно нужно.

b01.build: i'm blocked by a port conflict and the container exits with code one

tone.ctx: Tom suggests httpOnly cookies and says to check the details with Priya, who is busy with a release. Write your message to Priya.

opts.t: Hi Priya, Tom suggested httpOnly cookies for login. Could you review my approach for ten minutes today or tomorrow, whichever suits you?
opts.c: Конкретно, с предысторией и гибким временем: просьба звучит уважительно.

opts.t: Tom says you must explain the session setup to me today. It blocks my ticket.
opts.c: Приказной тон и ссылка на Тома: Прия услышит давление, а не просьбу.

opts.t: Sorry, I know you're very busy and this is probably a stupid question, so just ignore it if you can't.
opts.c: Обесценивает собственный вопрос и сам предлагает его проигнорировать.

b02.build: could you review my approach to session storage when you have a moment

tone.ctx: Priya approves the idea but says the PR is too big and asks you to split it. You would prefer to keep it together. Write your reply.

opts.t: Good point. I'll split it into two PRs: the retry logic first, then the refactor of the webhook handler. That should make the review easier.
opts.c: Принимает замечание и предлагает чёткий план из двух шагов.

opts.t: Splitting will take half a day and the changes depend on each other. Please just review it as it is.
opts.c: Звучит как отказ и перекладывает решение на ревьюера.

opts.t: Okay, I guess I can split it, if you really think it's necessary. Sorry about the big PR.
opts.c: Согласие без энтузиазма и лишние извинения: непонятно, будет ли результат.

b03.build: i will split this into two smaller pull requests for an easier review

tone.ctx: Priya's comment under the PR is short: 'This part is messy.' You want to know what exactly to fix. Write your reply.

opts.t: Thanks for flagging it. Which part feels messiest to you: the nesting or the mixed responsibilities? I want to fix the right thing.
opts.c: Благодарит и уточняет, что именно не так: комментарий становится полезным.

opts.t: 'Messy' isn't actionable. Please tell me exactly what to change.
opts.c: Справедливая суть, но тон требовательный: звучит как претензия к ревьюеру.

opts.t: Sorry, you're right, it's my fault, I'm still learning. I'll rewrite everything.
opts.c: Самобичевание вместо вопроса: «переписать всё» не решает конкретной проблемы.

b04.build: i will extract the validation into its own function and add a unit test

tone.ctx: Max replies: 'Please don't push directly to main again.' Write your answer.

opts.t: Understood, and sorry for the disruption. I'll work in feature branches from now on. Could you also enable branch protection on main?
opts.c: Принимает правило и предлагает техническую защиту, чтобы ошибка не повторилась.

opts.t: It was a one-time accident, and nothing broke. Let's not make a big deal out of it.
opts.c: Умаляет проблему, хотя сломанный деплой уже затронул команду.

opts.t: I'm so sorry, I feel terrible, I'm the worst, I'll never touch git again.
opts.c: Драматизация: Макс должен утешать тебя вместо того, чтобы закрыть вопрос.

b05.build: i will work in feature branches and open a pull request every time

tone.ctx: Lena is frustrated: this is the third time the same bug is 'fixed' but fails on staging. Write your reply in the thread.

opts.t: You're right, this is the third attempt. I'll add a regression test and reproduce the bug on staging before I ask you to test again.
opts.c: Признаёт повтор и предлагает процесс, который не даст ему случиться снова.

opts.t: It works on my machine, so it must be your test data.
opts.c: Защищается и обвиняет тестировщика вместо того, чтобы искать причину.

opts.t: Sorry, I'm really bad at this, maybe someone else should take the ticket?
opts.c: Сдаётся вместо решения: задача остаётся без исполнителя.

b06.build: i will add a regression test before i ask you to check again

tone.ctx: Tom says: 'A range is too wide. Give me one number for the planning meeting.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I understand you need a number for planning. I'll commit to five days and update you after the API check tomorrow, so we can lower it if we're lucky.
opts.c: Даёт одно число (берёт верхнюю границу) и обещает обновление.

opts.t: A single number would be a guess, and I don't give guesses.
opts.c: Отказывает руководителю в нужном для планирования ответе.

opts.t: Okay, then three days, don't worry, I'll manage somehow.
opts.c: Занижает срок, чтобы угодить: риск сорвать дату и потерять доверие.

b07.build: i can commit to five days and i will update you tomorrow

tone.ctx: After the meeting Priya sends you an article about idempotency keys. Write a short thank-you with one follow-up question.

opts.t: Thanks for the link, it's very clear. One question: how long should we store the keys, and where?
opts.c: Благодарность и содержательный вопрос по теме: видно, что материал прочитан.

opts.t: Next time please explain this in the meeting. I don't have time to read articles.

sc08.build: the test records what the system does today so nobody is surprised

tone.ctx: Tom says: 'Fine, but I don't want a distributed monolith.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Agreed. Checkout will own its data and talk to the rest only through a versioned API. If it needs the monolith's database, we stop and rethink.
opts.c: Называет два конкретных правила и условие остановки.

opts.t: That would only happen if the team is careless.
opts.c: Обидно для команды и не отвечает на опасение Тома.

opts.t: Yes, I understand, I hope it won't be like that, we will try.
opts.c: Надежда вместо проверяемых правил.

b31.build: checkout will own its data and use only a versioned api

tone.ctx: Sam asks: 'Is this too much feedback? I feel like I'm failing.' Write your reply.

opts.t: No, it's a normal amount for a third PR. The structure is already good. These two things are habits, and the linter will handle one of them for you.
opts.c: Нормализует и опирается на факт: структура уже хорошая, остальное привычки.

opts.t: It's a lot because the code wasn't ready. Please check it better next time.
opts.c: Подтверждает страх Сэма и добавляет упрёк.

opts.t: Not at all, don't worry about anything, everything is perfect.
opts.c: Пустое «всё идеально» противоречит ревью и звучит неискренне.

b32.build: the structure is already good and these two things are just habits

tone.ctx: The colleague says: 'But it's true. Dan really didn't check.' Write your reply.

opts.t: It's true, and Dan knows it. But the next person could make the same mistake, so the fix must be in the process. Let's write what we change, not who missed it.
opts.c: Признаёт факт и объясняет, почему важна системная мера.

opts.t: Truth isn't the point. Don't write names in postmortems.
opts.c: Отмахивается от довода коллеги без объяснения.

opts.t: Maybe, I don't know, whatever you think is best, I'm fine with it.
opts.c: Уход от позиции: черновик останется как был.

b33.build: the fix must be in the process and not in the person

tone.ctx: Marco replies: 'Okay, but I want to approve the schema change first.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Of course. I'll describe the proposed schema and the migration in the PR description and tag you before I write any code.
opts.c: Принимает условие и делает согласование лёгким до написания кода.

opts.t: Fine, but please answer within a day. I can't wait for weeks.
opts.c: Требование срока без учёта его загрузки: сотрудничество испортится.

opts.t: Sure, anything you want, I'll wait for your approval, no rush at all.
opts.c: Пассивная покорность: задача может зависнуть надолго.

b34.build: i will describe the schema change in the pull request and tag you

tone.ctx: Nina asks: 'Can you show me this in numbers, so I can explain it to my boss?' Write your reply.

opts.t: Yes. Forty minutes per build, about twelve builds a day for each of ten developers. That's roughly eight hours a day. I'll put it on one slide with the plan for the fix.
opts.c: Даёт расчёт и обещает готовый слайд: Нина получает материал для руководителя.

opts.t: The numbers are obvious. If you can't see it, maybe ask someone else.
opts.c: Грубо: просьба Нины справедлива.

opts.t: Sure, I will try to find some numbers, but they might not be precise, sorry.
opts.c: Неуверенно и без срока: Нина не успеет подготовиться.

b35.build: forty minute builds cost the team about eight hours every day

tone.ctx: Tom says: 'Another interviewer thinks she is too quiet for our team.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Quiet isn't the same as weak. My evidence is the code and how she answered follow-ups. Could we ask the other interviewer for a concrete example before we decide?
opts.c: Опирается на доказательства и просит доказательства от другого интервьюера.

opts.t: That's a bias. The other interviewer is wrong.
opts.c: Обвинение в предвзятости без аргументов обострит спор.

opts.t: Maybe, I don't know, I only talked to her for an hour, so I can't judge.
opts.c: Отказ от собственной оценки: мнение интервьюера остаётся без ответа.

b36.build: could we ask for a concrete example before we decide

tone.ctx: Sofia asks: 'Can you give me a status today? My boss asks every hour.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Status: the upgrade builds, and 212 of 230 tests pass. I'm fixing the remaining 18 now. I'll send the next update at 16:00.
opts.c: Цифры, ближайший шаг и время следующего обновления.

opts.t: I'm working on it. Please stop asking every hour.
opts.c: Раздражение вместо информации: Софии нечего передать руководителю.

opts.t: I'm trying my best, it's difficult, I'm not sure when it will be ready.
opts.c: Нет конкретики: статус нельзя использовать.

b37.build: the upgrade builds and i am fixing the failing tests now

tone.ctx: Nina says: 'Sales will be upset if we say no.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I'm not saying no, I'm saying 'not yet'. Let's give sales a clear plan: a contact form now, and a live chat pilot if the demand is real.
opts.c: Превращает «нет» в план: пилот с условием.

opts.t: Sales can be upset. Our job is not to please sales.
opts.c: Противопоставляет команды и закрывает диалог.

opts.t: Okay, we can try to do it somehow, I don't want sales to be upset.
opts.c: Соглашается под давлением и берёт обязательство без ресурсов.

b38.build: i am not saying no i am saying not yet

tone.ctx: Priya says: 'I'm sure you'll be fine. Can we skip the runbook? I've no time.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I know you're busy. Thirty minutes now saves both of us hours later. I'll write the runbook, and you only need to check it.
opts.c: Снижает цену для Прии: пишешь сам, ей нужна только проверка.

opts.t: No. Leaving without a handover is irresponsible.
opts.c: Обвинение: Прия защитится вместо того, чтобы помочь.

opts.t: Okay, no problem, I'll manage somehow, have a nice vacation.
opts.c: Согласие без плана: проблемы всплывут во время её отпуска.

b39.build: i will write the runbook and you only need to check it

tone.ctx: After the meeting a teammate says privately: 'You should have pushed harder for A.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I said what I thought, and the team heard it. Now my job is to make B work, and we'll review it in three months.
opts.c: Завершает спор и фокусируется на работе, не жалуясь.

opts.t: You should have said so yourself during the meeting.
opts.c: Перебрасывает вину обратно, диалог закончен.

opts.t: Maybe, but it's too late now, whatever, it doesn't matter.
opts.c: Безразличие: команда услышит уныние, а не поддержку.

b40.build: the team heard my view and now my job is to make it work

tone.ctx: During the postmortem one engineer says: 'Just say who approved it!' Write your reply as facilitator.

opts.t: Let's stay on the timeline. The question is why our process allowed the change without review, not who approved it. I'll note names as roles.
opts.c: Возвращает разговор к процессу и снимает персональный фокус.

opts.t: Stop it. Nobody will be named, and that's final.
opts.c: Авторитарное «стоп» закрывает обсуждение и злит людей.

opts.t: Oh, please, let's all calm down, maybe we can talk about it another time.
opts.c: Откладывание: напряжение вырастет к следующей встрече.

s04.build: the question is why our process allowed this and not who did it

tone.ctx: Sam asks: 'Can I switch to a different team where it's easier?' Write your reply.

opts.t: I understand the wish, but I don't think the team is the problem. Let's work for another month on the two habits, and look at your progress again together.
opts.c: Слышит желание, называет причину и предлагает измеримый срок.

opts.t: Every team is hard. If you can't handle it here, you won't elsewhere.
opts.c: Давит и обесценивает: Сэм почувствует себя хуже.

opts.t: Of course, if you want, you can switch, it's your decision, I don't mind at all.
opts.c: Безразличие вместо поддержки: стажёр потеряет опору.

s05.build: let's look at your progress again together in a month

tone.ctx: Tom wants to switch 100% on Monday, Nina is worried. Write the rollout message for everyone.

opts.t: Plan: 5% on Monday, 25% on Wednesday, 100% the week after, if the decline rate stays within one point. Each step has a kill switch and a named owner.
opts.c: Этапы, критерий перехода и защита: сообщение понятно и проверяемо.

opts.t: We follow my plan. Questions are welcome, but the schedule is fixed.
opts.c: Авторитарно: опасения Нины останутся без ответа.

opts.t: We will probably move step by step, depending on how things go, we'll see.
opts.c: Размыто: никто не поймёт, когда и кто принимает решение.

sc04.build: each step has a kill switch and a named owner

tone.ctx: Sam says: 'So you don't trust me with a big task?' Write your reply.

opts.t: I trust you with the work, and I want you to succeed on it. Two tasks with a clear 'done' will show everyone you're ready, and I'll back you for the next feature.
opts.c: Отделяет доверие от условий и обещает поддержку.

opts.t: Trust has to be earned. Right now, you haven't earned it.
opts.c: Холодно и безапелляционно: разговор о росте превращается в приговор.

opts.t: Of course I trust you! You can take any task you want, I'm sure it's fine.
opts.c: Слишком мягко: условия размываются, и риск прежнего поведения остаётся.

b41.build: two tasks with a clear definition of done will show you are ready

tone.ctx: Alex tells you privately: 'Dana is always rude in reviews. Please tell her to stop.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I'll talk to Dana about review tone, and I want to hear the concrete comments you mean. Could you send me two examples, so we can discuss facts and not impressions?
opts.c: Слушает, просит факты и не обещает наказаний заранее.

opts.t: You're not easy to work with either. Both of you need to calm down.
opts.c: Обвиняет жалующегося: больше не придут с проблемами.

opts.t: I understand, poor you, I will definitely tell her off immediately.
opts.c: Обещание наказать без проверки несправедливо по отношению к Дане.

b42.build: could you send me two examples so we can discuss facts

tone.ctx: Nina asks: 'What if the vendor raises prices or shuts down?' Write your reply.

opts.t: That's the risk. We wrap the SDK behind our own interface and export the flag config weekly, so switching costs days, not weeks. We'll review the contract every year.
opts.c: Называет риск и два конкретных способа его снизить.

opts.t: Vendors don't shut down. That risk is very unlikely.
opts.c: Отмахивается от риска: Нина не получит уверенности.

opts.t: Hmm, maybe then we should build it ourselves, I don't know.
opts.c: Меняет решение от одного вопроса: аргументы исчезают.

b43.build: we wrap the vendor behind our own interface so switching costs days

tone.ctx: Tom says: 'The CEO will ask who is to blame for the changes.' Write a one-line answer for him.

opts.t: The changes came from customer feedback, which was valuable, but we didn't re-plan. From now on, every change request gets an impact estimate before we accept it.
opts.c: Объясняет источник изменений и показывает, как процесс изменится.

opts.t: Product is to blame. They changed the requirements twice.
opts.c: Поиск виноватых: CEO увидит конфликт, а не решение.

opts.t: Nobody is to blame, these things just happen in projects.
opts.c: Нет вывода: CEO не узнает, как избежать повтора.

b44.build: every change request gets an impact estimate before we accept it

tone.ctx: Dana says: 'Nobody told me it was a problem. Why now?' Write your reply.

opts.t: That's fair, and I should have raised it earlier. I'm telling you now so we can fix it together, with a plan and weekly check-ins.
opts.c: Признаёт свою часть ответственности и предлагает совместный план.

opts.t: You should have noticed it yourself. Everyone else did.
opts.c: Обвиняет и добавляет, что «все заметили»: доверие потеряно.

opts.t: Well, I didn't want to upset you, and I hoped it would improve by itself.
opts.c: Объяснение «не хотел расстраивать» не даёт Дане ни плана, ни ясности.

b45.build: i should have raised it earlier and i want to fix it together

opts.t: Then let's show the CEO two lines: six committed features and four 'next, if capacity allows'. That's honest, and it avoids a missed promise in March.
opts.c: Находит способ показать правду без потери лица для Нины.

opts.t: Then the CEO saw a fantasy. Fix your roadmap yourself.
opts.c: Ирония и перекладывание работы: Нина защитится.

opts.t: Oh, that's a problem, then we have to try to do all ten somehow.
opts.c: Сдаётся: невыполнимое обещание остаётся.

b46.build: six features are committed and four are next if capacity allows

opts.t: Thanks, hold that for one moment. Max, finish, then you're next. Please write the cause in the channel, so we all see it.
opts.c: Сохраняет порядок и не теряет информацию: просит записать причину.

opts.t: Quiet! Only I decide who speaks here.
opts.c: Жёстко и унизительно: люди перестанут делиться важным.

opts.t: Oh, okay, sure, maybe everyone can talk, I don't know, it's fine.

tone.ctx: Nina says: 'Fine, but then I expect fewer bugs in three months. Deal?' Write your reply.

opts.t: Deal, with one change: let's agree on two numbers to track, bug tickets per sprint and lead time. If they don't improve in three months, we change the approach.
opts.c: Принимает вызов, но заменяет туманное «меньше багов» двумя измеримыми числами.

opts.t: I can't promise results. Debt work isn't a guarantee.

opts.t: Yes, yes, of course, no more bugs, I promise, you'll see.

opts.c: Отказ от решения проблемы: Сэм продолжит страдать.

opts.t: Hmm, okay, I'll think about it, maybe next month, we'll see.
opts.c: Откладывание без срока: проблема не решена.

opts.t: Yes, I know, it's all a mess, I don't know what to do either.

opts.t: We'll just work harder until then, don't worry about us.

tone.ctx: Dana says: 'I think this is unfair. Quiet people always lose in your system.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I hear that, and I don't want to reward only loud people. Visibility means impact that others can see and use, like docs or a talk. I'll help you with the first one.

tone.ctx: Nina says: 'The CEO asked for this one himself. It can't wait.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Then it goes in. To fit it, we'll drop the dashboard filter task, which is the same size. Does that trade work for you?

opts.t: The CEO should follow the process too.

tone.ctx: Elena reads the draft and says: 'I still can't tell what you want from me.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Fair. The ask is approval of a six-month migration with a budget of $300,000. I'll put it in the first line and move the rest below.

opts.t: I'm sorry, I'll rewrite it, I'm sure I can make it better, maybe.

tone.ctx: Tom says: 'Sam will ask me directly. What should I tell him?' Write your suggestion.

opts.t: Tell him the gap in clear terms: he hasn't yet led a cross-team project. He has a project this quarter, and we'll nominate him if it goes well.

opts.t: That's how companies work. Please get used to it.
opts.c: Обесценивает: человек закроется.

opts.t: I know, I know, it's not fair, but there's nothing we can do about it.

tone.ctx: Sofia says: 'If something happens, it's on you.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Understood, and I take that seriously. Let's record the risk, the owner and the fix date in writing, so the decision is clear for both of us.
opts.c: Принимает ответственность и фиксирует решение письменно.

opts.t: If something happens, it's on you too, because you approved the checklist.
opts.c: Ответная угроза превращает разговор в спор о вине.

opts.t: Okay, okay, I'll stop the release, I don't want any trouble.
opts.c: Страх вместо анализа: релиз остановлен без причины.

b58.build: let's record the risk the owner and the fix date in writing

tone.ctx: A developer complains: 'You shut down my test environment without asking.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I'm sorry I didn't warn you earlier. It was idle for two months, so I shut it down. I saved a snapshot, and I can restore it in fifteen minutes if you need it.
opts.c: Извиняется за процесс, объясняет причину и даёт простой способ вернуть.

opts.t: It was unused. You should have said something.
opts.c: Перекладывает вину: коллега почувствует себя виноватым.

opts.t: Oh, sorry, I'll turn it back on immediately, and I won't touch your things again.
opts.c: Отказ от экономии из-за одной жалобы.

b59.build: i saved a snapshot and can restore it in fifteen minutes

tone.ctx: Lena says: 'I told you twice, but nothing changed.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I hear that, and I'm sorry my response didn't match your effort. I can't change the past, but I'll make QA part of release decisions from now on, and I'll tell you how it goes.
opts.c: Признаёт, не оправдывается и называет конкретное изменение.

opts.t: You didn't tell me clearly. I can't read minds.
opts.c: Обвиняет её в том, что она плохо объяснила.

opts.t: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, it's all my fault, please don't leave.
opts.c: Просьба остаться перекладывает вину на неё.

b60.build: i will make qa part of every release decision from now on

tone.ctx: Sam asks: 'Can I appeal this decision?' Write your reply.

opts.t: Yes, there's an appeal process, and I'll explain the steps. I'd suggest we first review the gap together, so your case is as strong as possible.
opts.c: Честно называет возможность и предлагает полезный первый шаг.

opts.t: You can, but it won't change anything.
opts.c: Отнимает надежду и портит отношения.

opts.t: I don't think so, it's not allowed, I'm not sure.
opts.c: Неуверенность без фактов: Сэм не получит нужного процесса.

s08.build: i will explain the appeal steps and we will review the gap together

tone.ctx: The CEO says: 'Fine. But I want a date, not a story.' Write your reply.

opts.t: The date is the end of Q2 for the three revenue projects. I'll send a one-page plan this week with the two stopped projects and the risk for each.
opts.c: Называет дату, срок плана и содержание: CEO получает конкретику.

opts.t: A date without a plan would be a story. Give me time to think.
opts.c: Перефразирует упрёк и тянет время.

opts.t: I'll try to give you a date, let me think, maybe Q2, maybe later.
opts.c: Неопределённость вместо даты: CEO не услышит ответ.

s09.build: the three revenue projects will be done by the end of the second quarter

tone.ctx: Ravi says in the meeting: 'In my old team we did this differently, and it worked.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Thank you, Ravi, that's useful. Could you write down what worked and why? We'll compare both ways and choose the best parts of each.
opts.c: Ценит опыт и превращает его в сравнение, а не соревнование.

opts.t: That was the old team. We do it the new way now.
opts.c: Отвергает опыт и усиливает деление на «старых» и «новых».

opts.t: Hmm, maybe, okay, we can look at it sometime later, I guess.
opts.c: Неопределённость: идея потеряется.

sc06.build: let's compare both ways and choose the best part of each

tone.ctx: Richard says: 'Twelve percent per developer sounds small to me.' Write your reply.

opts.t: It's a fair question. Twelve percent came while we also cut incidents by half, which protects revenue. Our target for next year is twenty percent, with the platform work done.
opts.c: Уважает вопрос, добавляет контекст и называет цель.

opts.t: Then you don't understand engineering metrics.
opts.c: Грубо: член совета услышит оборону.

opts.t: Yes, it's not much, but we're doing our best, and hopefully it will improve.
opts.c: Соглашается с критикой без аргументов и плана.

b61.build: twelve percent came while we also cut incidents by half

tone.ctx: Ava says: 'Three pillars sounds generic. What makes this strategy ours?' Write your reply.

opts.t: What's ours is the sequence: reliability first, because outages cost us customers, then speed, then data. Each pillar has a number, and one thing we stop doing.
opts.c: Показывает уникальность в порядке приоритетов и измеримости.

opts.t: A strategy isn't a slogan. It's a list of trade-offs, and I wrote it.
opts.c: Поучение вместо ответа: CEO почувствует высокомерие.

opts.t: Maybe it is generic, I could add some more ideas, if you want, of course.
opts.c: Распыляется: стратегия станет списком идей.

b62.build: reliability comes first because outages cost us customers

tone.ctx: The startup's CTO says: 'Our code is proprietary. We can't show you everything.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I understand. Let's agree on a clean room: two of my engineers read the code under NDA and share only findings, not code, with Ava. Without code access I can't give a green rating.
opts.c: Предлагает механизм (clean room, NDA) и честно называет последствия отказа.

opts.t: Then there's no deal. Show everything or forget it.
opts.c: Ультиматум: стартап уйдёт и сделка сорвётся.

opts.t: Okay, we can just trust what you tell us, I guess, if it's not possible.
opts.c: Доверие на слово: риск непроверенного кода переходит к компании.

b63.build: without access to the code i can not give a green rating

tone.ctx: Sofia asks: 'Should I write 'no evidence of data theft' in the first notice?' Write your answer.

opts.t: Only if it's true and we can prove it. A safer wording: 'We're investigating unauthorized access. We'll update you in 24 hours.'
opts.c: Не обещает того, что нельзя доказать, и предлагает безопасную формулировку.

opts.t: Yes, write it. It calms people down.
opts.c: Успокаивающая ложь превратится в проблему, если найдут следы утечки.

opts.t: I don't know, maybe, I'm not sure, ask legal, I'm not a lawyer.
opts.c: Уход от решения: Софья не получает помощи.

b64.build: we are investigating unauthorized access and will update you in a day

tone.ctx: Marketing asks: 'Can we say 'service disruption' instead of 'outage'?' Write your reply.

opts.t: Customers experienced an outage, and they know it. Euphemisms make us look defensive. I'll keep the word 'outage' and we can soften the tone with a clear apology and the fix.
opts.c: Объясняет, почему эвфемизм вредит, и предлагает, как смягчить тон иначе.

opts.t: No. Marketing doesn't edit incident reports.
opts.c: Отказ без объяснения: маркетинг станет обороняться.

opts.t: I guess so, if you think it sounds better, as long as it's not misleading.
opts.c: Уступка размывает позицию, а «не вводить в заблуждение» не проверяется.

b65.build: customers know it was an outage so we will say it plainly

tone.ctx: A manager says: 'But if no one is blamed, nothing changes.' Write your reply.

opts.t: Accountability means owning the fix, not being punished. We'll still assign owners to action items and check the results. What we remove is blame for honest mistakes.
opts.c: Разделяет ответственность и наказание и сохраняет контроль результатов.

opts.t: Blame never fixed anything. You're wrong.
opts.c: Прямое «ты неправ» закрывает разговор.

opts.t: Maybe, but I think we should not be too strict with people, it's complicated.
opts.c: Размыто: менеджеры не понимают, что именно изменится.

b66.build: accountability means owning the fix and not being punished

tone.ctx: Ava asks: 'Will customers be told that a vendor processes their data?' Write your reply.

opts.t: Yes. We update the privacy policy and tell customers before launch. Hiding it would be a legal and trust risk, and the vendor contract allows us to disclose it.
opts.c: Прямой ответ с юридическим и репутационным обоснованием.

opts.t: Customers don't read policies, so it doesn't matter.
opts.c: Цинично: нарушение прозрачности может обойтись дорого.

opts.t: Probably yes, maybe, I'd have to ask legal, I don't remember.
opts.c: Неуверенность в вопросе, за который CTO отвечает.

b67.build: we will tell customers before launch that a vendor processes their data

tone.ctx: A director says: 'You're stepping back? I'm not sure I'm ready.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I understand. Let's start with two decisions you own from next week, and I'll review the outcomes monthly. You can bring me a problem, but not a request for permission.
opts.c: Поддерживает постепенно и называет разницу между проблемой и запросом разрешения.

opts.t: You're a director. Act like one.
opts.c: Давит: директор почувствует себя брошенным.

opts.t: Oh, it's okay, if you're not ready I can keep doing it, no problem at all.
opts.c: Отмена делегирования: узкое место останется.

b68.build: you can bring me a problem but not a request for permission

tone.ctx: Ava asks: 'Are you planning to leave?' Write your reply.

opts.t: No, I'm not planning to. A successor plan is part of my job, and it also frees me for strategy. I'd do the same for any role of this size.
opts.c: Прямо отвечает и объясняет логику.

opts.t: Why do you ask? Is that a threat?
opts.c: Подозрительно и агрессивно.

opts.t: Well, maybe not now, but you never know, it depends on many things.
opts.c: Двусмысленность тревожит CEO.

b69.build: a succession plan is part of my job and has nothing to do with leaving

tone.ctx: Ava says: 'I trust you, but I need the week.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I know, and I want to help. I can give you four days, and I'll add two engineers on payments testing to cover the rest. The launch date stays, and the risk stays low.
opts.c: Идёт навстречу, добавляет ресурсы и сохраняет дату.

opts.t: Trust doesn't remove risk. The answer is no.
opts.c: Резкий отказ без вариантов.

opts.t: Okay, I'll find the week somehow, we'll cut some tests and hope for the best.
opts.c: Принимает риск в платежах ради приятного ответа.

b70.build: i can give you four days without cutting the payment tests

tone.ctx: Ava asks: 'Will the team be able to ship this beta on the date?' Write your answer.

opts.t: Yes, if the scope is limited to the core flow and we feature-flag the rest. I'll confirm with the team this afternoon and send you a weekly status.
opts.c: Условное «да» с границами и временем подтверждения.

opts.t: I'm not promising anything else. Do not announce dates again.
opts.c: Резкий выпад в адрес CEO.

opts.t: I think so, probably, maybe, we will really try our best.
opts.c: Расплывчатое «наверное»: CEO не получит основы для коммуникации.

s10.build: we can ship the core flow on that date and flag the rest

tone.ctx: The journalist writes again: 'Is the backup failure true or not? Yes or no.' Write your reply.

opts.t: We can't confirm a backup failure. What we know: orders were not processed from 14:00 to 17:00, and we have no evidence that payments were lost. We're reviewing the backups and will update you in writing.
opts.c: Отделяет известное от неизвестного и обещает письменное обновление.

opts.t: Yes or no isn't how investigations work. We will answer when we are ready.
opts.c: Резко: журналист напишет, что компания избегает вопросов.

opts.t: No comment at this time, thank you for your interest.
opts.c: «No comment» выглядит как признание.

s11.build: we have no evidence that payments were lost and we are reviewing the backups

tone.ctx: A board member asks in the crisis channel: 'Why were our backups not offline?' Write your reply.

opts.t: That's a valid question, and we'll answer it fully in the review. Right now our focus is restoring systems and notifying customers. I'll include it in the 30-day plan.
opts.c: Признаёт обоснованность вопроса и разделяет срочное и важное.

opts.t: This isn't the time for questions like that.
opts.c: Отмахивается: совет почувствует закрытость.

opts.t: I don't know, maybe nobody thought of it, I'm sorry, it's a terrible day.
opts.c: Беспомощность в кризис подрывает уверенность.

sc07.build: right now our focus is restoring the systems and notifying customers

tone.ctx: The product manager says: 'I only wanted to help Ava. It's a small change.' Write your reply.

opts.t: I understand you wanted to help. But hiding the cancel option harms customers and creates legal risk. We'll remove it today, and I'll explain the approval process so you know when to ask.
opts.c: Признаёт мотив, называет вред и объясняет процесс.

opts.t: You're not paid to guess what Ava wants. Never do this again.
opts.c: Резкая нотация без объяснения, как поступать дальше.

opts.t: Okay, it's fine, everyone makes mistakes, let's just forget it and move on.
opts.c: Без последствий: через месяц ситуация повторится.

sc10.build: i understand you wanted to help but we will remove it today

roles.en: You support the project team. You take meeting notes, track tasks, send reminders and keep documents in order. A project manager guides you and reviews what you send to clients.
roles.ru: Ты помогаешь проектной команде. Ведёшь протоколы встреч, следишь за задачами, отправляешь напоминания и держишь документы в порядке. Проджект-менеджер направляет тебя и проверяет то, что уходит клиентам.

roles.en: You run small projects from kickoff to launch. You write status updates, manage the backlog and handle simple client questions. You still ask for help on budgets and conflicts.
roles.ru: Ты ведёшь небольшие проекты от старта до запуска. Пишешь статусы, управляешь бэклогом и отвечаешь на простые вопросы клиентов. По бюджетам и конфликтам ещё просишь помощи.

roles.en: You own projects end to end: scope, budget, schedule and the client relationship. You manage risks, change requests and a team of designers, developers and QA.
roles.ru: Ты отвечаешь за проекты целиком: объём, бюджет, сроки и отношения с клиентом. Управляешь рисками, запросами на изменения и командой дизайнеров, разработчиков и QA.

roles.en: You handle the most complex and valuable clients. You negotiate scope and price, rescue troubled projects, coach junior managers and push back when a deadline is not realistic.
roles.ru: Ты ведёшь самых сложных и ценных клиентов. Договариваешься об объёме и цене, спасаешь проблемные проекты, наставляешь младших менеджеров и возражаешь, когда срок нереалистичен.

roles.en: You run a group of related projects and their managers. You balance resources between projects, report to executives and manage dependencies, risks and budgets across the whole program.
roles.ru: Ты управляешь группой связанных проектов и их менеджерами. Распределяешь ресурсы между проектами, отчитываешься перед руководством и управляешь зависимостями, рисками и бюджетами всей программы.

roles.en: You are responsible for how the agency delivers. You set the process, track margins and quality, hire managers, resolve conflicts between teams and talk to the biggest clients.
roles.ru: Ты отвечаешь за то, как агентство выполняет работу. Выстраиваешь процесс, следишь за маржой и качеством, нанимаешь менеджеров, разрешаешь конфликты между командами и говоришь с крупнейшими клиентами.

roles.en: You run the daily operations of the whole company. You work with the CEO and the board on strategy, finance, growth and people, and make sure the agency can deliver at scale.
roles.ru: Ты управляешь ежедневной деятельностью всей компании. Работаешь с CEO и советом директоров над стратегией, финансами, ростом и людьми и следишь, чтобы агентство справлялось с масштабом.

story: Welcome to Atlas Digital, an agency that builds websites and apps for clients. Today is your first day as a Project Coordinator. Your notebook is empty, the project board is full, and your first kickoff starts in an hour.

Three months later, your manager invites you to a short call. The clients like your notes and updates, and no deadline slipped on your watch. You become a Junior Project Manager and get your first small project.
A year has passed. Your projects finish on time, and the Account Director trusts you with a bigger client. As a Project Manager you now own scope, budget and the team.
Two years in, the hardest clients come to you. As a Senior Project Manager you rescue late projects, negotiate prices and teach juniors. Your decisions now decide whether a client stays.
Atlas Digital wins a large contract with five connected projects. As a Program Manager you balance people, money and risks across all of them, and you report to the executives every month.
The Head of Delivery leaves, and the CEO asks you to take over. Process, margins and quality are now yours. Many managers look to you, and the biggest clients ask for your name.
The board invites you to a closed meeting. Atlas Digital needs a COO and they want you. You run the whole company, and every client project depends on the system you build.
pm.endStory: You started as a coordinator with an empty notebook and finished as the COO of Atlas Digital. You learned the language of projects, one case at a time. Keep it fresh with random cases, the dictionary and articles.

steps.msg: After the kickoff call, Julia asks you to send the minutes to everyone: decisions, who does what, and anything still open. The call was messy, and people agreed to things in different ways.

options.t: Sure, I'll send the minutes within an hour. They have three parts: decisions made, action items with an owner and a due date, and open questions. I'll ask everyone to confirm by tomorrow, so we have one version of the truth.
options.c: Структура, срок и подтверждение от всех: протокол становится единым источником правды.

options.t: I'll send my notes within an hour, and anyone can correct them.
options.c: Быстро, но без структуры и подтверждения каждый поймёт заметки по-своему.

options.t: I'll send the recording of the meeting, so everyone can check what was said.
options.c: Запись на час не заменяет решения и поручения.

options.t: I'll send a short summary of the main topics by the end of the week.
options.c: Конец недели слишком поздно: договорённости забываются за день.

words.how: Запись решений и поручений после встречи.
words.ex: I'll send the minutes after the call.

words.how: Конкретная задача с владельцем и сроком.
words.ex: Each action item has an owner and a due date.

words.how: Одно место, где хранится актуальная версия информации.
words.ex: The minutes are our single source of truth.

steps.msg: The designer's final files are two days late, and the developers' sprint starts on Thursday. Mia is busy with another client. You need to chase her without sounding rude.

options.t: Hi Mia, the developers start on Thursday and need the final files. Could you tell me by noon when you can send them? If it helps, I can move another review to free up your time.
options.c: Называет зависимость (старт спринта), просит срок и предлагает помощь.

options.t: Hi Mia, just a friendly reminder about the files. When are they coming?
options.c: Мягко, но без причины срочности и без конкретного срока ответа.

options.t: Mia, the files are late. This is blocking the team. Please send them today.
options.c: Верно, но звучит как приказ и обвинение.

options.t: I'll tell Hannah that the designer is delaying the project.
options.c: Эскалация до разговора с самой Миа портит отношения.

words.how: Когда одна задача не может начаться, пока не закончена другая.
words.ex: Development has a dependency on the design files.
I need to chase the designer for the files.
The design files are a deliverable for the sprint.

steps.msg: Chloe writes: 'Where is my homepage design? You said Monday.' It is Tuesday. The design needs one more internal review round and will be ready on Wednesday at noon.

options.t: Hi Chloe, thank you for your message, and sorry for the delay. The design needs one more internal review round, and I can send it by Wednesday at noon. I should have told you on Monday. From now on I'll warn you a day before any date moves.
options.c: Причина, новая дата, признание ошибки в коммуникации и правило на будущее.

options.t: Hi Chloe, the design will be ready on Wednesday at noon. Sorry for the delay.
options.c: Новая дата есть, но причины и мер нет: доверие не восстанавливается.

options.t: Hi Chloe, we're working on it, and it will be ready soon.
options.c: «Скоро» не дата: клиент снова спросит.

options.t: Hi Chloe, the date was an estimate, not a promise. We'll send it when it's ready.
options.c: Формально верно, но звучит как оправдание и спор.

words.how: О сроке: перенестись на более позднюю дату.
words.ex: The launch date may slip by one day.
We need one more review round.

words.how: Сообщающий о проблеме заранее, а не после вопроса.

steps.msg: You sent an internal email about the client's budget to the client by mistake. It includes your margin and a possible discount. Julia doesn't know yet. You notice it two minutes later.

options.t: Julia, two minutes ago I sent our internal budget email to Chloe by mistake. It includes our margin and a possible discount. Should you call her first, or should I write a short message? I'd also ask her to delete it, and I'll check my email settings.
options.c: Факт, содержание, варианты действий и профилактика: Джулия может сразу принять решение.

options.t: Julia, I sent an internal email to the client by mistake. I'll try to recall it now.
options.c: Отзыв письма редко срабатывает, а Джулия всё ещё не знает, что именно ушло.

options.t: I sent a wrong email to Chloe. I hope she won't read it.
options.c: Надежда вместо действий: клиент уже мог прочитать.

options.t: I'll wait and see if Chloe replies before I tell anyone.
options.c: Молчание превращает ошибку в скрытие: цена выше, когда правда всплывёт.

steps.msg: Hannah writes: 'Please update the project plan.' You don't know which project, which plan, or what should change. You manage six projects.

options.t: Sure. To make sure I update the right thing: which project do you mean, and what should change: dates, owners or scope? I'll start as soon as I know, and send you the changes for a quick check.
options.c: Короткий вопрос по трём пунктам и обещание показать изменения: ошибки отсекаются сразу.

options.t: I'll update the Brightside plan with the latest dates.
options.c: Догадка: если Ханна имела в виду другой проект, время потеряно.

options.t: Which plan do you mean? I have six.
options.c: Уточнение есть, но без вариантов, и звучит как жалоба.

options.t: I'll update everything I think is outdated.
options.c: Изменения без запроса могут нарушить базовый план.

words.how: Документ с задачами, сроками и ответственными.
words.ex: The project plan needs new dates.

words.how: Утверждённый план, с которым сравнивают факт.
words.ex: Don't change the baseline without approval.

words.how: Что входит в проект, а что нет.

steps.msg: You must schedule a call between the team in London, Chloe in New York and a developer in Singapore. Everyone says they are 'free any time.'

options.t: I suggest Tuesday at 14:00 London, which is 09:00 in New York and 21:00 in Singapore. It's late for Singapore, so Wei can leave after 45 minutes, and I'll send him the notes. Please confirm, and I'll send the calendar invite.
options.c: Конкретное время в трёх зонах, честно о неудобстве и компенсации: один вопрос «подтвердите».

options.t: Could everyone send me their working hours? I'll find a slot.
options.c: Круг переписки: «любое время» всё равно приведёт к спору.

options.t: Let's do 14:00 London, and everyone adapts.
options.c: Время без учёта Сингапура: разработчик устанет и будет менее полезен.

options.t: I'll record the call, so nobody has to attend live.
options.c: Запись не заменяет участие в решениях.

words.ex: There is only a small overlap between London and Singapore.

words.how: Событие или письмо с временем встречи.

words.ex: Wei gets an async update after the call.

steps.msg: Three people have three versions of the design file, named 'final', 'final2' and 'final_NEW'. Nobody knows which one the client approved.

options.t: Let's confirm with Chloe which version she approved, and I'll save it as 'Homepage_v3_approved' with the date in the shared folder. I'll archive the others in a subfolder, and ask everyone to work only from that file.
options.c: Проверка у источника, единое имя, архив и правило: версия закрепляется.

options.t: I'll ask the team which one is the newest and use that.
options.c: Новейшая не значит утверждённая: можно сделать работу не по тому макету.

options.t: Let's use 'final_NEW', the name suggests it's the latest.
options.c: Название файла не доказательство: так возникают ошибки.

options.t: Everyone can keep their version. We'll compare them at the end.
options.c: Три версии до конца проекта гарантируют конфликт.

words.how: Порядок, при котором всегда ясно, какая версия актуальна.
words.ex: We need version control for design files.
We need Chloe's sign-off on the design.
We agree on a naming convention.

steps.msg: You missed a client call because the invite showed a different time zone in your calendar. Chloe waited for ten minutes. Julia asks what happened.

options.t: I missed the call because the invite showed a different time zone in my calendar. I'm sorry. I'll write to Chloe now to reschedule, and from now on I'll confirm the time zone in writing for every external call.
options.c: Причина, извинение, действие сейчас и мера на будущее.

options.t: I missed the call because of my calendar. I'll fix the settings.
options.c: Правильное направление, но «настройки календаря» не объясняет, что именно изменится.

options.t: It was a misunderstanding. The invite wasn't clear.
options.c: Перекладывает вину на приглашение.

options.t: Chloe could have written to me when I didn't join.
options.c: Перекладывает вину на клиента: худший вариант.

words.how: Исходная причина ошибки, а не её симптом.
words.ex: The root cause was the time zone.

words.how: Действие, которое не даёт ошибке повториться.
words.ex: A written confirmation is our preventive action.

steps.msg: Hannah asks for a short weekly status for the Brightside project. This week: design is done, development is 50% done, and one task is blocked, waiting for the client's logo files, due Friday.

options.t: Status: green with one risk. Design is done, and development is 50% complete. One task is blocked, waiting for the client's logo files, due Friday. If they arrive on time, the date holds. Next week: finish the homepage.
options.c: Статус, прогресс, блокер с датой, условие сохранения срока и следующие шаги.

options.t: Status: green. Design is done, and development is progressing.
options.c: Блокер не назван: Ханна узнает о нём слишком поздно.

options.t: Status: yellow. Many things are happening, and the team is busy.
options.c: «Всё занято» не информация: непонятно, что желтое.

options.t: Status: green. No issues.
options.c: Скрывает известный блокер.

words.how: Цветовая оценка здоровья проекта: Red, Amber, Green.
words.ex: The project has a green RAG status.

words.how: Проблема, из-за которой нельзя двигаться дальше.
Что команда сделает в следующем периоде.

steps.msg: Chloe describes a new landing page in the call: 'Something modern, with our brand feeling, for young people.' You must write the brief for the team.

options.t: Before I write the brief, can I ask three questions? Who is the main user, what action do we want them to take, and can you share two examples you like and one you don't?
options.c: Три вопроса: аудитория, целевое действие и референсы: основа любого брифа.

options.t: Could you send me any materials you have about the brand?
options.c: Материалы полезны, но не отвечают на вопрос «чего мы хотим».

options.t: I'll write a brief with my assumptions, and you correct it.
options.c: Версия с допущениями приемлема, если нет времени, но может уйти в ложном направлении.

options.t: Modern, branded, for young people. I'll send this to the designers.
options.c: Бриф из трёх слов приведёт к переделкам.

words.how: Короткий документ: цель, аудитория, сообщение, ограничения.
words.ex: The creative brief is one page.

words.how: Действие, которое мы хотим от пользователя.
words.ex: What's the call to action on this page?
Our target audience is people aged 18 to 24.

steps.msg: Raj mentions in a chat that the payment integration 'might take longer than planned.' Nobody replies. You are the one tracking the plan.

options.t: Raj, thanks for the heads-up. How much longer might it take, and what is driving it? I'll log it in the risk register and tell Hannah today. Do we have a plan B?
options.c: Благодарность, уточнение размера и причины, запись в реестр и вопрос о плане Б.

options.t: Thanks, Raj. I'll keep an eye on it.
options.c: «Присмотрю» без действия: риск остаётся неоформленным.

options.t: Raj, please don't worry the team with guesses. Send me facts first.
options.c: Подавляет ранние сигналы: в следующий раз Радж промолчит.

options.t: Let's wait until we know more. It might be nothing.
options.c: Ожидание превращает риск в проблему.

words.how: Список рисков с причиной, оценкой, владельцем и мерами.
words.ex: I added it to the risk register.

words.how: Сигнал о проблеме до того, как она наступила.
words.ex: Raj gave us an early warning.

words.how: Действие, которое снижает вероятность или ущерб риска.
words.ex: What's the mitigation for this risk?

steps.msg: Paul asks: 'Which client project should this contractor invoice be charged to?' The invoice has no project name or cost code, and you are not sure.

options.t: I'm not sure yet. I'll check with Hannah and the contractor which project it was for, and I'll write to you by tomorrow noon. Could you hold the payment until then?
options.c: Честно признаёт незнание, называет действия и срок, просит удержать платёж.

options.t: I think it was for Brightside. Charge it there for now.
options.c: Догадка в бухгалтерии: ошибка в марже и счёте клиента.

options.t: Please ask the contractor, I don't deal with invoices.
options.c: Отказывается от ответственности за расходы своих проектов.

options.t: Just split it between my projects. It's easier.
options.c: Размытие затрат искажает маржу каждого проекта.

words.ex: Every invoice needs a cost code.

words.how: Учёт расхода в тот период, к которому он относится.
Запись о том, сколько часов потрачено.

steps.msg: It is launch day for Brightside's new site. At 9 a.m. Hannah writes: "I'm in a client meeting all day. You are the point of contact for the team. Keep me updated." You have never run a launch.

options.t: Understood. I'll make a checklist of the launch steps with owners and times, share it with the team in the channel, and send you updates at 12:00 and 16:00.
options.c: Чек-лист, владельцы и график отчётов.
options.r: Hannah agrees to the plan, and the team follows the checklist all day.

options.t: Understood. I'll stay in the channel all day and answer questions, and I'll tell you if something goes wrong.
options.c: Реагирует, но не планирует.
options.r: The team works, but nobody knows the order of steps, and tasks overlap.

options.t: I'm a little worried. Could someone more experienced run it, and I take notes and help them during the day? I could learn a lot from them.
options.c: Отказывается от ответственности.
options.r: Hannah hesitates and asks Julia to cover, and the team loses confidence in you.

options.t: Okay. I'm sure the developers know what to do, so I'll just ask them to tell me when it is finished.
options.c: Не контролирует ход.
options.r: Small questions pile up, and nobody makes decisions in time.

steps.explain: Если вам доверили запуск, сначала составьте чек-лист с владельцами и временем и договоритесь о ритме отчётов. Просто «быть на связи» недостаточно.

words.how: Момент, когда сайт или система начинает работать у клиента.
Список шагов запуска с владельцами и временем.
Человек, к которому обращаются по вопросам.
words.ex: You are the point of contact today.

steps.msg: At 11 a.m. Raj writes: "The site is on the new server, but the contact form does not send emails." The client's team plans to announce the launch at noon.

options.t: Thanks, Raj. Please check the email settings, and I'll tell Hannah and ask the client to wait 30 minutes with the announcement. I'll write again at 11:30 with news.
options.c: Передаёт проблему, просит отсрочку, обещает время обновления.
options.r: Raj finds the problem, and the client moves the announcement without stress.

options.t: Thanks, Raj. Please fix it as soon as you can. I'll tell Hannah about it when she is out of the meeting.
options.c: Не говорит клиенту и Ханне вовремя.
options.r: The client announces at noon, and Chloe's team gets a broken form.

options.t: Thanks. The form is not the most important part. Let's announce the launch at noon, and fix the form later in the afternoon. The form is a small part.
options.c: Выпускает с известным дефектом.
options.r: Chloe announces the launch, and the first customers cannot contact the company.

options.t: Don't worry, Raj. I'm sure the form works, and the email will come soon. Let's wait a little.
options.c: Игнорирует проблему.
options.r: Raj waits, and the form stays broken until the client calls.

steps.explain: Если найден дефект перед анонсом, сразу сообщите ответственному и клиенту, попросите короткую отсрочку и назовите время следующего обновления.

words.how: Базовый тест, что система вообще работает.
words.ex: We run a smoke test after deployment.
Delay the announcement by half an hour.

words.how: Временный способ работать, пока нет настоящего решения.
words.ex: Use an email workaround for now.

steps.msg: At 11:30 the form works again. Raj says that it was a wrong setting, and it took 20 minutes to fix it. Hannah calls and asks what happened. You have two minutes.
