options.t: The contact form did not send emails because of a wrong mail setting. Raj fixed it at 11:25 and tested it. I asked the client to delay the announcement by half an hour. All fine now.
options.c: Причина, решение, действия и итог.
options.r: Hannah thanks you and tells the client everything is under control.

options.t: There was a small problem with the form, but the team fixed it. We are on schedule now, and the client knows. The client is calm, and I'd not give details that create new questions.
options.c: Кратко, но без причины и проверки.
options.r: Hannah wants more details and calls Raj to ask the same.

options.t: There were many issues this morning. Raj and I worked on them, and it was quite stressful, but we managed.
options.c: Эмоции вместо фактов.
options.r: Hannah feels unsure and asks to join the channel for the rest of the day.

options.t: Everything is fine, Hannah. It was only a small thing, and there is nothing to worry about.
options.c: Скрывает инцидент.
options.r: Hannah later learns the real story from the client and loses trust.

steps.explain: Для руководителя итог должен быть коротким: что случилось, причина, решение и текущий статус.

words.ex: The root cause was a wrong mail setting.

words.how: Короткое описание сбоя и его причины.
words.ex: Write an incident note for Hannah.

words.how: Небольшая правка вне обычного цикла релизов.

steps.msg: At 3 p.m. Chloe writes: "A user says the site is slow on mobile. Can you check?" The developers are testing the last pages. Hannah is still in her meeting.

options.t: Thanks, Chloe. I'll ask Raj to check mobile speed now. I'll write to you by 4 p.m. with what we find, and I'll ask which phone and city your user has.
options.c: Берёт задачу, уточняет детали и называет время.
options.r: Raj checks mobile speed, and Chloe sees that you care about her users.

options.t: Thanks, Chloe. I'll pass it to the team. Can you tell me more about it?
options.c: Принимает, но срок не называет.
options.r: Chloe waits, then asks again two hours later.

options.t: It's launch day, so some slowness is normal. The server is new, and it will become faster after some hours.
options.c: Обесценивает сигнал клиента.
options.r: Chloe feels ignored and writes to Julia.

options.t: I'll check it myself. I used the site on my phone this morning and it was fast, so I think the problem is on the user's side. Last week another user also said it was slow.
options.c: Решает по одному случаю.
options.r: The developers find a slow image after all, and Chloe asks why you did not check.

steps.explain: Сообщение клиента на запуске нужно принять, уточнить детали и назвать, когда вы ответите. Не отмахивайтесь и не спорьте до проверки.

words.ex: A user reported a performance issue.
Ask the user for repro steps.
Check the page speed on mobile.

steps.msg: At 6 p.m. the site is live and stable. Hannah asks you to prepare the end-of-day message to the client and the team. What do you include?

options.t: Thank you to everyone. The site is live, the form works, and mobile speed is being checked. Tomorrow at 10:00 we monitor and send you a summary. Please send any issues to this channel.
options.c: Благодарность, статус, следующий шаг, канал.
options.r: Chloe replies with a thank you, and the team reads your plan for tomorrow.

options.t: The site is live! Thanks to the whole team for the hard work. If you notice any problems, let us know.
options.c: Тепло, но без плана на завтра.
options.r: Chloe is happy, but nobody knows who watches the site tomorrow.

options.t: The site is live. During the day we had some small problems, but we fixed them, so there is nothing to worry about. Nobody complained to us during the day. I'd write a short message with good news to the client.
options.c: Упоминает проблемы без деталей.
options.r: Chloe asks what the problems were, and you must explain in a new message.

options.t: The site is live. We are now tired and will rest. We'll write again on Monday if there is anything.
options.c: Оставляет клиента без поддержки в первые часы.
options.r: Chloe worries over the weekend and calls Julia on Saturday.

steps.explain: Итоговое сообщение запуска включает благодарность, текущий статус, следующий шаг и канал для вопросов.

words.how: Период, когда команда особенно внимательно следит за системой.
Краткая сводка: что сделано, что в работе.
words.ex: Send an end-of-day report to the client.

endings.good: The launch went well and everyone knew what was happening. The client praises Atlas, and the team starts to ask for you on their projects.
endings.mid: The site is live, but the day was stressful and some messages were late. The team sees that you need a clearer plan.
endings.bad: The launch was messy, the client is unhappy, and the team now checks your messages twice. You learn how important a launch checklist is.

steps.msg: This is your first kickoff as the project manager. Julia asks you to open the meeting. The client, Chloe, and five team members are waiting.

options.t: Hello everyone, thanks for joining. Today we agree on the goal, the timeline and who does what. We have 45 minutes. Chloe, could you start by telling us what success looks like to you? Then I'll walk through scope, milestones and the first risks.
options.c: Цель встречи, регламент, вопрос клиенту об успехе и план: встреча с ясной структурой.

options.t: Hello everyone. Let me present the project plan, and then we'll take questions.
options.c: План без согласования цели: клиент услышит чужое видение.

options.t: Hi all, let's introduce ourselves, and then we'll see where the meeting goes.
options.c: Без повестки встреча разойдётся без решений.

options.t: Julia, would you like to start? You know the client better.
options.c: Отказ от роли: вы — менеджер проекта.

words.how: Первая встреча, где команда и клиент согласуют цель, сроки и роли.
Как мы поймём, что проект удался.
words.ex: We define the success criteria with the client.
The first milestone is the design sign-off.

steps.msg: Chloe writes: 'Can we also add a small blog section? It's quick.' The blog is not in the contract and needs about three days of work.

options.t: Thanks, Chloe. A blog is possible. It's about three days, and it's not in the current scope. I'll send you the cost and the effect on the date, and you can decide whether to add it now or after launch.
options.c: Не отказывает и не берёт молча: называет объём, обещает цену и влияние на дату.

options.t: Thanks, Chloe. We can add it, and I'll check the effect on the date.
options.c: «Добавим» до оценки: обязательство без цены.

options.t: Of course, we'll add the blog for free, since it is small.
options.c: Бесплатная доработка приучает клиента к расширению объёма.

options.t: Unfortunately the blog is not in the contract, so we can't do it.
options.c: Прямой отказ без варианта: клиент услышит «нет».

words.ex: A blog is out of scope.

words.how: Формальная просьба изменить объём, срок или бюджет.
words.ex: I'll send you a change request.

words.how: Анализ того, как изменение повлияет на срок, цену и риски.
words.ex: I'll do an impact assessment first.

steps.msg: Your project is two days behind because the client sent the content late. You write the weekly status for Hannah and are afraid to show a yellow status.

options.t: Status: yellow. We are two days behind because the client sent the content on Wednesday, not Monday. If the rest of the content arrives by Friday, we keep the launch date. Otherwise we move it by two days. I've asked Chloe to confirm by Friday.
options.c: Честный статус с причиной, условием сохранения даты и запросом клиенту.

options.t: Status: green. We are two days behind, but we can catch up with overtime.
options.c: Зелёный при отставании и ставка на переработки: нарушает доверие и темп команды.

options.t: Status: yellow. We are behind because of the client.
options.c: Верный цвет, но без плана и обвинение клиента.

options.t: Status: green. Everything is fine, and I'll tell you if something changes.
options.c: Скрывает отставание: Ханна узнает слишком поздно.

words.how: Насколько фактические сроки отстают от плана.
words.ex: We have two days of slippage.
The recovery plan needs the content on Friday.

words.how: Дата, после которой риск становится проблемой.
words.ex: Friday is the trigger date for the content.

steps.msg: The backlog has 80 tickets. Many have no description. Raj says he cannot plan the sprint from it. You must prepare the backlog for planning.

options.t: I'll go through the top 20 tickets today and add a description and acceptance criteria. The rest I'll mark 'to refine,' and we'll look at them in next week's refinement. Can you join for 30 minutes to estimate the top ones?
options.c: Берёт на себя приоритетные тикеты, остальное метит и просит время у технического лидера.

options.t: I'll ask the team to add descriptions to their own tickets this week.
options.c: Перекладывает работу, а спринт откладывается.

options.t: Let's plan the sprint from the tickets that have descriptions.
options.c: Планирование по неполному списку оставит важные задачи за бортом.

options.t: Let's delete the old tickets and start a new backlog.
options.c: Удаление теряет контекст: часть тикетов может быть важной.

words.how: Регулярная работа: уточнить, оценить и упорядочить задачи.
Условия, при которых задача считается выполненной.

words.ex: The team estimates in story points.

steps.msg: Raj estimates a feature at 'about two weeks.' The client expects one week. You are in a call with both and don't know who is right.

options.t: Raj, what's included in two weeks, and what's the main risk? Chloe, I'd like to check the scope with you, so we can find a version that fits one week. Then I'll bring both of you a short comparison.
options.c: Сравнивает состав работ с обеих сторон и ищет версию, которая укладывается в неделю.

options.t: Let's split the difference and say ten days.
options.c: Среднее арифметическое без анализа: оценка ничем не подкреплена.

options.t: Raj, can you do it in one week if the team works harder?
options.c: Давление на команду вместо разговора о составе работы.

options.t: Chloe, the developers say two weeks. That's the estimate.
options.c: Теряет клиента: он слышит «нет» без вариантов.

words.how: Оценка с оптимистичным, реалистичным и пессимистичным значениями.
То, что считаем верным, пока не проверили.
words.ex: This estimate has one big assumption.

words.how: Выбор, что убрать, чтобы уложиться в срок.

steps.msg: In the retro the team says the client changed the design three times. Mia is angry and says: 'It's your fault, you didn't stop them.' Everyone looks at you.

options.t: You're right that I should have set a limit on revisions at the start. Let's agree now: two rounds of changes per page, and any extra round is a change request. I'll add it to the plan and explain it to Chloe this week.
options.c: Признаёт упущение, вводит чёткое правило и берёт на себя разговор с клиентом.

options.t: The client changes things a lot, and we should note it for future projects.
options.c: Наблюдение без действия: Миа не почувствует, что её услышали.

options.t: It's not my fault. The contract has no limit on revisions.
options.c: Верно формально, но звучит как оправдание.

options.t: Let's move on. The design is done, and it doesn't matter now.
options.c: Игнорирует проблему и чувства команды.

words.how: Один цикл правок по комментариям клиента.
words.ex: The contract allows two revision rounds.

words.how: Встреча команды: что сработало, что улучшить.
Правило, которое защищает проект от повторения проблемы.
words.ex: A revision limit is a guardrail.

steps.msg: You sent the design to Chloe five days ago and asked for approval. She has not answered. The developers need the answer to start.

options.t: Hi Chloe, a quick reminder: we need your approval of the homepage by Thursday, or the launch moves by one day for each day of delay. Can you confirm by then? If you have comments, even a short list is enough for us to continue.
options.c: Срок, последствия и лёгкий способ ответить: клиенту проще ответить, чем молчать.

options.t: Hi Chloe, just checking if you had time to look at the homepage design.
options.c: Слишком мягко: нет срока и последствий.

options.t: Hi Chloe, we've been waiting for five days. This is delaying the whole project.
options.c: Упрёк: клиент защитится, а не ответит.

options.t: Hi Chloe, we will assume it's approved if we don't hear from you.
options.c: Односторонне «считать утверждённым» без условия в договоре — риск конфликта.

words.ex: We need your sign-off on the homepage.

words.how: Сколько времени отводят на проверку и ответ.
words.ex: Our turnaround time for approvals is 48 hours.

words.how: Правило: если клиент молчит определённый срок, результат считается принятым.
words.ex: The contract has a deemed approved clause.

steps.msg: Ben, the QA engineer, has been late with test reports twice. The next report is due tomorrow, and the release depends on it.

options.t: Hi Ben, the test report for the release is due tomorrow at 12:00. Is there anything that could stop you? If yes, tell me today, and we'll find a way to help, for example by cutting the test scope.
options.c: Называет срок и последствия, спрашивает о препятствиях и предлагает сократить объём.

options.t: Hi Ben, a reminder about the report tomorrow. Please send it on time.
options.c: Напоминание без вопроса о причинах.

options.t: Ben, you were late twice. If it happens again, I'll speak to Hannah.
options.c: Угроза эскалацией до разговора: Бен закроется.

options.t: Hi Ben, take your time with the report. Quality is more important than speed.
options.c: Снимает срок: релиз зависит от отчёта.

words.how: Документ о том, что проверено и какие дефекты найдены.
words.ex: The test report is due at noon.

words.how: Условие, без которого релиз не выходит.
words.ex: The test report is a release gate.
Ben may have a capacity problem.

steps.msg: In a call Chloe says: 'Honestly, I'm not happy with the speed. Other agencies would be faster.' You are surprised, because the project is on schedule.

options.t: I hear you, Chloe. Can you tell me what you expected to see by now? I'd like to show you where we are against the plan, and agree what to improve.
options.c: Слушает, выясняет ожидания и показывает факт против плана: разрыв ожиданий закрывается данными.

options.t: I'm sorry you feel that way. The plan is on track, so I don't think speed is a problem.
options.c: Спорит с чувствами клиента.

options.t: Other agencies might be faster, but they may cut quality.
options.c: Обесценивает конкурентов и оборонительно.

options.t: Let me check with the team and call you back.
options.c: Откладывание не показывает, что клиента услышали.

words.how: Сравнение запланированного и фактического хода работ.
words.ex: I'll show you plan versus actual.

words.how: Разница между тем, чего ждёт клиент, и тем, что делает команда.
Документ о том, что сделано и что осталось.
words.ex: I'll send a progress report today.

steps.msg: Chloe sends a new request: three more pages and a new payment method. She says it must be done "within the same budget and date, because it is a small thing."

options.t: Thank you, Chloe. These are good ideas, but together they are about 12 days of work. We can do them with a budget and date change, or we can choose one of the two for now and keep the plan. Which do you prefer?
options.c: Показывает цену и два варианта.

options.t: Thanks, Chloe. I'll check with the team how big it is and write to you tomorrow with the details. I'll do my best to find a solution. I understand that it is not an easy request. I'd like Chloe to see that we take it seriously.
options.c: Откладывает ответ на день.

options.t: I'm sorry, but we can't do this in the same budget and date. It's too much work, and the team is already busy.
options.c: Отказ без вариантов.

options.t: Okay, Chloe. We'll try to fit it in. I'll tell the team that there are a few extra requests, and we will manage somehow.
options.c: Соглашается молча.

words.how: Процесс оценки и утверждения изменений проекта.
words.ex: Every addition goes through change control.

words.how: Утверждённый бюджет, с которым сравнивают расходы.
words.ex: The change affects the budget baseline.

words.how: Выигрыш в одном за счёт потери в другом.

steps.msg: Chloe answers: "I don't want to pay extra, but the payment method is a must. Can't you remove something else?" The team has a list of planned features.

options.t: We can swap: if we move the photo gallery to the second phase, we have the time to add the payment method. I'll send you the new plan today for approval.
options.c: Предлагает обмен и срок плана.

options.t: Yes, we can look at that. Which features are less important for you? We can then see what is possible within the same budget.
options.c: Спрашивает, но не предлагает вариант.

options.t: I understand. I'll ask my manager whether we can give you a discount for the new payment method this time.
options.c: Уступает цену без обсуждения.

options.t: I'm afraid we can't remove anything. Everything in the plan was agreed with you, and we need to keep our promise. We agreed on this scope with the client.
options.c: Отказывается обсуждать.

words.how: Добавить одну функцию, убрав другую равного размера.
words.ex: A scope swap keeps the budget.

words.how: То, без чего запуск не имеет смысла.
words.ex: The payment method is a must-have.

words.how: То, что можно отложить без вреда.
words.ex: The photo gallery is a nice-to-have.

steps.msg: Mia and Raj argue in the project channel. Mia says the developers changed her design without asking. Raj says the design could not be built as drawn. Other people watch.

options.t: Mia, Raj, let's take this out of the channel. I'll set a 15-minute call today. I want to understand what changed and why, and then we can agree how to avoid it.
options.c: Уводит в разговор и называет цель.

options.t: Please, let's keep it polite. We are all on the same team, and the main goal is a good result for the client. Maybe we can have a break and then continue. The discussion is becoming too emotional.
options.c: Призыв к спокойствию без решения.

options.t: I think both of you have a point. Mia, the design is good, and Raj, you have technical limits. Let's find a middle way.
options.c: Оба правы, но конкретики нет.

options.t: I'll ask Hannah to talk with both of you, because it's not my role to solve conflicts between the team members.
options.c: Уходит от ответственности.

words.how: Успокоить конфликт и вернуть разговор к делу.
words.ex: I need to de-escalate this thread.

words.how: Перенести разговор из публичного чата в личный или звонок.
Подход, где ищут причины, а не людей.

steps.msg: On the call Mia says: "I spent two weeks on this design, and developers change it in an hour." Raj says: "The animation will make the page slow, and I told you three times." Both are right.

options.t: I hear both of you. Mia, your time was important. Raj, the speed risk is real. Let's agree: developers talk to the designer before they change anything, and we test the animation on mobile today.
options.c: Признаёт обе стороны и вводит правило.

options.t: Let's all calm down. I'll write a short note about what each of you needs, and then we can discuss it again tomorrow.
options.c: Откладывает решение.

options.t: Raj, please apologize to Mia, and Mia, please listen to the speed problem. We are a team, and we need to respect each other.
options.c: Обязывает извиняться.

options.t: I think the client will decide. Let's show both versions to Chloe, and she can choose. We have already spent too much time on the discussion. The client knows her users. Her choice is probably better than anything that we can suggest.
options.c: Отдаёт спор клиенту.

words.ex: Raj questions the feasibility of the animation.

words.how: Передача результата от одного участника другому.
words.ex: The design handoff to developers is unclear.

words.how: Встреча, где команда обсуждает макеты до разработки.

steps.msg: Paul says your project used 70% of its budget, but only 50% of the work is done. He asks: "Why are the numbers different?"

options.t: I'll check this today and write back by 5 p.m. My first guess is the extra design rounds and one contractor. I'll show you the hours by task so you can see where they went.
options.c: Не оправдывается, называет срок и план проверки.

options.t: It's possible that the hours were higher at the start because of the setup. I think it will balance out later in the project. The first phase always costs more because of the setup.
options.c: Предполагает без данных.

options.t: I think the numbers are not accurate. The timesheets are usually not filled in correctly, so the 70% may be too high.
options.c: Ставит под сомнение данные.

options.t: I'm not sure, I'm new in this role. Maybe Julia can answer this question better than I can.
options.c: Переносит вопрос на другого.

words.ex: Our burn rate is too high.

words.how: Стоимость фактически выполненной работы в бюджетных единицах.
words.ex: Earned value is lower than actual cost.

steps.msg: You find that the extra design rounds cost 60 hours, and nobody told the client. Paul asks what you will do about the budget.

options.t: I'll write to Julia and Chloe today: 60 extra hours, why, and two options: a change request, or we reduce the next phase. I'd also add a rule: more than two rounds need approval.
options.c: Прозрачность, варианты и правило.

options.t: I'll tell Julia and ask her how to handle this with the client. She has more experience, and she can decide. Julia has dealt with this client for years. I'd not like to decide a client matter myself.
options.c: Эскалирует без предложений.

options.t: We can absorb the cost, because it was our decision to allow extra rounds. I'll make sure it doesn't happen again.
options.c: Принимает убыток без обсуждения.

options.t: Let's not mention it to the client now. We'll see at the end whether we are over budget, and then we will explain. The hours may change during the project.
options.c: Скрывает перерасход.

words.ex: The cost overrun is sixty hours.

words.how: Не перекладывать лишние затраты на клиента.
words.ex: We cannot absorb the cost every time.

words.how: Часы, за которые клиент не платит.
words.ex: Sixty unbillable hours hurt our margin.

steps.msg: Three weeks before the deadline of your first own project, you see that 40% of the tasks are not started. The team is busy with two other projects. Julia asks in the Monday sync: "How is it going?"

options.t: I'm worried about the date. 40% of the tasks are not started and the team is split between projects. I'd like to meet you today to choose which scope goes first and what resources I need.
options.c: Называет проблему и просит решения.
options.r: Julia clears two developers for you and asks for a plan by tomorrow.

options.t: It's going okay. We're a bit behind, but I think the team will catch up in the next two weeks if nothing else happens.
options.c: Занижает риск.
options.r: Julia notes the risk, but the delay grows for another week.

options.t: It's tough because the team is busy elsewhere. I think the other projects should give me more time from their people.
options.c: Требует ресурсов без плана.
options.r: Julia says the other projects have deadlines too, and you lose a week in a discussion.

options.t: It's going fine, Julia. I don't need any help for now, and I'll tell you if something changes. I have enough work to manage on my own. I'd not like to take time from you. I will call her only if the plan changes.
options.c: Прячет проблему.
options.r: Julia learns about the problem only two weeks later, when it is almost too late.

steps.explain: Когда срок под угрозой, говорите об этом рано, называйте цифры и просите конкретное решение: приоритет или ресурсы.

words.how: Когда одни и те же люди нужны на нескольких проектах.
words.ex: There's a resource conflict between two projects.

words.how: Выбор, что делать в первую очередь.

words.ex: Unstarted tasks are on the critical path.

steps.msg: Julia gives you two developers for two weeks, but one week of scope still does not fit. She asks: "What can the client live without?" You know that Chloe loves the animations.

options.t: I'd move the blog and the animations to phase two. The core flow, the payment and the contact form stay. Can I propose this to Chloe with a clear date for phase two?
options.c: Предлагает отложить второстепенное с датой.
options.r: Chloe agrees to look at the plan, and the date for phase two is set.

options.t: I'd cut the blog and some small features. Maybe the client won't mind, and we keep the animations since Chloe likes them. The client reads the site mostly for the shop.
options.c: Режет не то и не спрашивает клиента.
options.r: The team keeps the animations, and the missing scope still does not fit.

options.t: I think we should ask Chloe what she can live without. She knows her business, and then we can decide together.
options.c: Пока ничего не предлагает.
options.r: Chloe says she does not like to choose without knowing the cost.

options.t: I'd keep everything and ask the team to work in the evenings and the weekend. It's only for two weeks, and the client will be happy.
options.c: Строит план на перегрузке.
options.r: The team starts to work evenings, and the quality drops in week two.

steps.explain: Если объём не помещается, вместе с клиентом сокращайте второстепенное и предложите дату следующего этапа. Переработки не решают проблему.

words.how: Деление на must, should, could, won't.
words.ex: Use MoSCoW to rank the scope.

words.how: Часть объёма, перенесённая на следующий этап.
words.ex: The blog goes to phase two.

steps.msg: Chloe says no to cutting the animations: "They are the main reason I chose Atlas." She asks if there is a way to keep them.

options.t: Yes. We keep a lighter version of the animations on the homepage only, and add the rest in phase two. This keeps the main effect and saves about three days. Shall I send the new plan?
options.c: Находит вариант, сохраняя ценность.
options.r: Chloe agrees to the lighter version, and the plan fits the date.

options.t: I understand. Let me talk to the developers about whether we can do everything, and I'll write to you tomorrow.
options.c: Откладывает ответ.
options.r: Chloe waits a day, and you lose time for the decision.

options.t: If you want all the animations, we need to move the launch by two weeks. It's the only option.
options.c: Один вариант, давление на клиента.
options.r: Chloe feels pushed and asks Julia to join the next call.

options.t: Okay, we keep the animations. We'll find a way, and I'll tell the team to do their best. The team always finds a way when the date is fixed. I will motivate them to do their best.
options.c: Принимает без плана.
options.r: The team does not know how to keep all animations, and the date moves quietly.

steps.explain: Клиент ценит не функцию целиком, а эффект. Найдите облегчённый вариант, который сохраняет ценность и экономит время.

words.how: Версия с основным эффектом и меньшей сложностью.
words.ex: Offer a lite version of the animations.
The effort saving is three days.

steps.msg: One week before launch, Ben finds a serious bug in the payment flow. Fixing it takes two days. The team is tired. What do you do?

options.t: Fix the bug first, and I'll move the final review one day later. I'll tell Chloe and Julia today, protect the team from extra late hours, and give one day off to the developer who fixes it.
options.c: Исправляет, сообщает, бережёт людей.
options.r: Chloe thanks you for the early warning, and the payment bug is fixed on Friday.

options.t: Let's fix it quickly. The developers will stay late for two days, and we keep the same date, so that the client is not disturbed.
options.c: Сохраняет дату ценой команды.
options.r: The bug is fixed, but one developer is exhausted and makes mistakes in the next task.

options.t: Let's launch and fix it after. The bug only affects a few users, and the client will not notice at first. A fix needs two more days of testing. Chloe expects the site on Monday. We will put the fix in the first update.
options.c: Выпускает с дефектом платежей.
options.r: The first customers find the bug, and the client asks why nobody warned them.

options.t: Let's not tell the client about it. We'll fix it quietly in the background and hope nobody finds out.
options.c: Скрывает проблему.
options.r: A customer finds the payment bug on the first day, and Chloe is angry.

steps.explain: Серьёзную ошибку в платежах исправляют до запуска. Сообщите клиенту, сдвиньте мелкие этапы и берегите команду.

words.how: Насколько сильно дефект влияет на пользователей.
words.ex: The payment bug has high severity.

words.how: Период перед релизом, когда новые изменения не принимают.
words.ex: Code freeze starts a week before launch.

endings.good: Your first project lands on time and within budget. Julia and the client trust you, and the team enjoys working with you.
endings.mid: The project finishes, but with a late night, a small overspend and a tired team. You see what you must plan better.
endings.bad: The project is late and over budget. The client loses trust, and the team feels you did not protect them.

steps.msg: Hannah opens your RAID log in the Monday review. It has two entries: 'delay' and 'budget.' She says: 'These are labels, not risks. I can't manage a label.'

options.t: Fair point. I'll rewrite them as risk statements: cause, event, impact. For example: 'Because the client's content may arrive late, the launch could slip by a week.' Each gets a probability, an impact score, an owner and a mitigation. I'll bring the updated log tomorrow.
options.c: Формулировка «причина, событие, последствие», оценка, владелец и меры: так риск становится управляемым.

options.t: I'll add more risks to the log, at least ten, so it looks more complete.
options.c: Количество без качества: десять расплывчатых записей не лучше двух.

options.t: They are the main risks. I didn't want to make the log too long.
options.c: Оправдание: Ханна просила конкретики.

options.t: I'll ask the team to send me their risks, and I'll paste them in.
options.c: Сбор без анализа: нет оценки и владельцев.

words.how: Реестр рисков, допущений, проблем и зависимостей: Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies.
words.ex: I update the RAID log every Monday.

words.how: Две оценки, по которым ранжируют риски.
words.ex: Score each risk by probability and impact.

words.how: Человек, отвечающий за наблюдение и меры по риску.
words.ex: Every risk needs a risk owner.

steps.msg: A developer adds a small extra feature because 'the client asked in a call.' It's not in the plan, the backlog or the budget. Julia asks if you know about it.

options.t: Yes, I just learned about it. I'll ask Raj to pause the work, and I'll send Chloe a change request today with the effort and the cost. If she approves, we add it to the baseline formally. If not, we remove it.
options.c: Остановить, оценить, оформить запрос и обновить базовый план: изменение проходит через контроль.

options.t: Yes. It's small, so let's finish it, and I'll mention it in the next report.
options.c: Скрытое изменение «маленькое» приучает команду к неформальным договорённостям.

options.t: No, I didn't know. I'll speak to the developer and tell him not to do it again.
options.c: Реакция на человека, а не на процесс: проблема останется.

options.t: Yes. The client asked for it, so we should do it for good relations.
options.c: Бесплатное расширение объёма создаёт прецедент.

words.how: Процесс оценки и утверждения изменений в проекте.
words.ex: All changes go through change control.

words.how: Согласие без документа, которое трудно доказать.
words.ex: A verbal agreement is not enough for a change.

words.how: Внести утверждённое изменение в плановые сроки и бюджет.
words.ex: If approved, we update the baseline.

steps.msg: Hannah says your plan has no buffer and asks for 20%. You think it will make the plan look slow to the client, who will ask why.

options.t: I'll add contingency only to the high-risk tasks, about 15% overall, and show the client where it sits: integrations and approvals. I'll explain that it protects the launch date, and that if we don't use it, we launch early.
options.c: Буфер на рисковые задачи, прозрачно для клиента и с объяснением выгоды.

options.t: I'll add 20% to every task. That's the simplest way.
options.c: Ровный запас на всё скрывает, где реальный риск, и раздувает срок.

options.t: I'll keep the plan short, and I'll add the buffer secretly, so the client doesn't see it.
options.c: Скрытый буфер: потеряете доверие, когда клиент поймёт.

options.t: I'll tell Hannah that the client will not accept a buffer.
options.c: Отказ без попытки объяснить: клиента не спросили.

words.how: Запас времени или бюджета на известные риски.
words.ex: We add contingency for the integration.
The buffer protects the launch date.

words.how: Скрытое увеличение оценок для безопасности: плохая практика.

steps.msg: The payment provider says its sandbox will be ready in two weeks, not two days. Your integration work cannot start without it, and the launch date is fixed.

options.t: Thanks for telling me, Raj. Let's ask the provider for a mock API today, so the developers can start. I'll update the risk log, and tomorrow I'll send Chloe the risk, the impact on the date, and plan B.
options.c: Обходной путь, обновлённый реестр рисков и открытое сообщение клиенту с планом Б.

options.t: Let's wait for the sandbox, and in the meantime the team can work on other tasks.
options.c: Ожидание без плана: другие задачи кончатся, а срок не двигается.

options.t: I'll write to the provider and ask them to hurry.
options.c: Просьба «поторопиться» — не план.

options.t: I'll tell Chloe the launch date will move by two weeks.
options.c: Сдвиг срока без поиска вариантов: рано.

words.how: Изолированная среда, в которой проверяют интеграцию без реальных платежей.
Имитация сервиса, которая позволяет работать, пока нет настоящего.
words.ex: We use a mock until the sandbox is ready.

words.how: Альтернативный путь, если основной не сработает.
words.ex: What is our plan B for the provider?

steps.msg: Greg, the client's CFO, writes to you and Julia: 'Why is the invoice 18% higher than the estimate? I need an explanation by tomorrow.' The tone is sharp.

options.t: Dear Greg, thank you for asking. The difference is 30 hours from two approved change requests, CR-4 and CR-7. I'll send you both signed approvals and a reconciliation by 3 p.m. today. I'm happy to walk you through it on a call.
options.c: Конкретные причины, документы-подтверждения, срок и предложение звонка.

options.t: Dear Greg, the estimate was only an estimate, and the final price depends on the work done.
options.c: Формально верно, но звучит как увёртка и ничего не объясняет.

options.t: Dear Greg, we'll check the invoice and come back to you next week.
options.c: Неделя при требовании «до завтра» разжигает конфликт.

options.t: Dear Greg, we will correct the invoice and take 10% off, to avoid a problem.
options.c: Скидка без разбора признаёт ошибку, которой могло не быть.

words.how: Формальная заявка на изменение объёма, срока или бюджета.
Сопоставление счёта с оценкой и утверждёнными изменениями.

words.ex: Both change requests have the client's approval.

steps.msg: Ben says there are 40 open bugs, and the launch is in five days. Raj says that 'most of them are small.' You must decide what to do before the go/no-go meeting.

options.t: Let's triage by severity and user impact: blocker, major, minor. Ben, can you do it by tomorrow? We fix blockers and majors before launch, and put minor bugs into the first post-launch release. I'll show Chloe the list in the go/no-go meeting.
options.c: Сортировка по серьёзности, понятное правило запуска и показ клиенту.

options.t: Let's fix as many bugs as we can in five days, and the rest after the launch.
options.c: Исправлять в порядке попадания, а не серьёзности: можно упустить блокер.

options.t: Raj is probably right, most of them are small, so let's launch on time.
options.c: Догадка вместо данных: «в основном мелкие» не проверено.

options.t: Let's postpone the launch until all 40 bugs are fixed.
options.c: Откладывать до нуля дефектов нереалистично.

words.how: Разбор багов по серьёзности и приоритету.
Насколько сильно дефект влияет на пользователей.
Встреча или решение: запускать или нет.
words.ex: The go/no-go meeting is on Thursday.

steps.msg: The project is finished. The support team asks for a handover, but the developers are already on a new project and have little time. The documentation is half ready.

options.t: Let's plan one hour: Raj walks support through the system, and I record it. I'll finish the documentation checklist today and share it with support by Friday. We keep a questions channel open for two weeks, as a hypercare period.
options.c: Короткая передача с записью, чек-лист документации и период поддержки: передача закрыта.

options.t: I'll send support the code repository link. They can find what they need.
options.c: Ссылка на код — не передача.

options.t: I'll ask the developers to write full documentation before they leave.
options.c: Полная документация снимет разработчиков с нового проекта.

options.t: Support can ask us when something breaks. We're always available.
options.c: «Спрашивайте» — это не процесс и не срок.

words.how: Формальная передача результата команде, которая будет его сопровождать.
Инструкция: как работает система и что делать при сбое.
Короткий период после запуска, когда команда проекта на связи.

steps.msg: Sales wants to sign a fixed-price contract for a project with vague requirements. Julia asks your opinion. You see that the scope is unclear and the client keeps changing the brief.

options.t: I wouldn't sign it as it is. Let's propose a paid two-week discovery first, then price the real scope. If the client wants one number now, we add a clear list of exclusions, a change control clause, and a contingency of 20%. Otherwise time and materials is safer.
options.c: Исследовательская фаза и защита фиксированной цены: исключения, контроль изменений, резерв.

options.t: Let's sign the fixed price, and we manage the scope carefully as we go.
options.c: Фикс без защиты: расползание объёма съест маржу.

options.t: Let's sign with a high price to cover all possible risks.
options.c: Завышенная цена отпугнёт клиента и не решит неопределённость.

options.t: I'd refuse the project. Unclear scope is always a problem.
options.c: Отказ без предложения теряет клиента.

words.how: Договор, где цена не зависит от затраченного времени.
words.ex: A fixed price needs a clear scope.

words.how: Клиент платит за фактически потраченные часы.
words.ex: T&M is safer for unclear scope.

words.how: Короткая платная работа: понять задачу и оценить проект.

steps.msg: After a project that finished a month late, Hannah asks you to run a lessons-learned session. The team is tired, and some people blame others.

options.t: Let's use three questions: what went well, what slowed us down, and what will we change? We talk about process, not people. I'll record actions with owners and dates, and we review them in a month. Anonymous input is possible before the meeting.
options.c: Структурированный формат без поиска виноватых и с проверкой действий через месяц.

options.t: Let's go through the timeline and find who caused each delay.
options.c: Поиск виноватых закроет людей и испортит выводы.

options.t: Let's skip it. The project is over, and the team needs a rest.
options.c: Без уроков те же проблемы повторятся.

options.t: I'll write the report myself and send it to everyone.
options.c: Отчёт в одиночку: команда не приняла участия.

words.how: Анализ завершённого проекта: что работает, что менять.
Человек, который доводит действие до результата.
words.ex: Each action has an action owner.

words.how: Подход, где обсуждают процесс, а не людей.

steps.msg: Chloe sees the final design and says: "This is not what I wanted. I don't like it." She approved the earlier sketches two weeks ago.

options.t: Thank you for being direct. Let's go through it together: what do you like, and what feels wrong? I'll write it down, and we can see which parts differ from the sketches you approved.
options.c: Слушает и разбирает по фактам.

options.t: I'm sorry, Chloe. I understand that it's frustrating. Let's take a short break, and then we can talk about how to fix the design.
options.c: Сочувствует, но разбор откладывает.

options.t: But you approved the sketches two weeks ago. The final design follows them, so I'm not sure what is wrong here. The design was reviewed in the last call, and nobody raised a concern then.
options.c: Ссылается на документ против клиента.

options.t: I'll talk to the designer. Maybe she can make some changes, and then we'll show it to you again next week.
options.c: Обещает правки без причин.

words.ex: The final design deviates from the sketches.

steps.msg: Chloe says: "The colors feel cold, and the layout is too busy." These are new comments, not in the sketches. The deadline is in 10 days, and there are two revisions left in the contract.

options.t: Thank you, that's clear. We can use one revision now for colors and layout. To keep the date, I need your feedback in one list by Thursday, and one more revision stays for the final check.
options.c: Использует правку и ставит условие по срокам.

options.t: Of course. I'll ask Mia to try some warmer colors and a simpler layout, and send you the new version when it is ready.
options.c: Принимает без условий.

options.t: These are new requests, so they will count as extra work. I'll send you a quote for the changes. The first quote was based on the old list of pages. Any new page changes the work plan.
options.c: Жёстко делает платной правкой.

options.t: Okay, we can do it. I'll tell the team to make all the changes you want, and we will see how it goes with the date.
options.c: Соглашается без границ.

words.how: Все комментарии клиента в одном списке.
Что считается правкой, а что новой работой.

steps.msg: Another project manager, Dan, asks you for Raj's time "for two days next week." Raj is fully booked on your project, and your deadline is close.

options.t: Hi Dan, Raj is at 100% on my project until the 20th. I can't give two days. But he could help for half a day on the 12th, and I can ask Hannah if we can find another developer for the rest.
options.c: Говорит о загрузке, предлагает часть и эскалирует разумно.

options.t: Hi Dan, I'm sorry, Raj is busy with me now. Let's ask Hannah how to share him between our projects. Let's ask Hannah how to share him. I don't want to decide this alone. A talk with all three PMs will help us.
options.c: Передаёт решение Ханне.

options.t: Hi Dan, sure. I think we can manage without him for two days, and the plan has some buffer for that.
options.c: Отдаёт ресурс без анализа.

options.t: Hi Dan, no. Raj is mine, and my project is more important than yours.
options.c: Конфликт приоритетов.

words.how: Сколько времени человека закреплено за проектом.
words.ex: Raj's allocation is 100% on my project.
Dan wants to borrow Raj for two days.

words.how: Сколько времени нужно до начала работы.
words.ex: Another developer needs a week of lead time.

steps.msg: Dan goes to Hannah, and Hannah asks you both in a short call: "I'll decide, so tell me the facts. What is the real impact on each project?"

options.t: Raj's two days move my launch by three days, and the client has a fixed event on the 25th. Dan's task can start on the 12th with Raj's half day, plus a new developer. I prefer this option.
options.c: Факты, влияние и предложение.

options.t: My project is close to the end, and I can't give Raj away without a delay. Dan's project has more time, so I think he can wait.
options.c: Верно, но звучит как защита своего.

options.t: I think both projects are important. I'm sure Hannah can find a good solution, and I will accept it. Hannah has seen both plans. She has more information about the other client than I do.
options.c: Не вносит фактов.

options.t: Honestly, Dan always asks for resources at the last moment. This is a planning problem on his side.
options.c: Критикует коллегу.

words.how: Последствие для сроков, бюджета или качества.
words.ex: The impact on my launch is three days.
The event on the 25th is a hard deadline.

steps.msg: Sales asks: "Can we promise the client an app in three months? We have a meeting in an hour. Give me a quick yes or no." You have only a one-page brief.

options.t: I can give you a range, not a promise. Based on similar projects it is four to five months for this scope. If the client needs three months, we can offer a smaller first release. I'd write "estimate, to be confirmed after discovery."
options.c: Диапазон и оговорка.

options.t: From one page I can't say. I'd say three to six months, and tell the client that we will know more after the first workshop.
options.c: Диапазон слишком широкий.

options.t: It's possible if everything goes well and the client approves quickly. I think we can say yes and manage the risks later. The client has said yes to our first offer before. A quick answer makes a good first impression.
options.c: Рискует обещанием.

options.t: No. Three months is not realistic for any app, and I don't want to promise something we can't do.
options.c: Категорично без объяснений.

words.ex: I can only give a ballpark.
Don't make a commitment from one page.

words.how: Встреча, где уточняют требования и оценку.

steps.msg: Sales says: "The client will choose another agency if we say four to five months. Competitors say three." What do you suggest?

options.t: Offer a first release in three months with the core features, and the rest in a second release in two months. We tell the client what is in each release. We win on clarity, not on a date we can't keep.
options.c: Реальный вариант вместо пустой даты.

options.t: Let's say three months and add "subject to scope confirmation." If the client agrees, we reduce the scope later.
options.c: Оговорка не защищает.

options.t: Let's say three months, and then we try to do our best. If we are late, we can explain it to the client. It is the usual time for a project of this size. The client can plan her launch campaign for the summer.
options.c: Обещает невозможное.

options.t: Let the competitors win this one. I don't want to start a project with the wrong expectations.
options.c: Отказывается от сделки.

words.ex: The MVP launches in three months.

words.how: То, что мы считаем верным, пока не проверили.

steps.msg: Greg, the client's CFO, calls you and Julia: "The project is three weeks late. The website is not live, and we lose sales every day. I am thinking of stopping the contract." He is angry. You have thirty seconds.

options.t: Greg, I understand. Our delay costs you money, and I'm sorry. Give me 48 hours. I'll bring you a recovery plan with a new date, what we do, and who does it. Can we meet on Thursday?
options.c: Признаёт проблему, просит время и называет результат.
options.r: Greg agrees to meet on Thursday, and he stops talking about ending the contract.

options.t: Greg, we are working hard to finish. The team is doing everything it can, and I'm sure we will launch soon.
options.c: Общие слова без плана.
options.r: Greg hears the same words again and asks for Julia's director to join.

options.t: Greg, the delay was caused by late content from your team. I can send you the dates and show the whole timeline. The content was due on the first of the month, and it arrived on the twentieth.
options.c: Объясняет причины, но спор не нужен.
options.r: Greg feels attacked and says the delay is the agency's job to fix.

options.t: Greg, please don't stop the contract. We will finish as soon as possible, and I promise that nothing like this will happen again.
options.c: Просит о милости без плана.
options.r: Greg says apologies are not a plan and asks for a written reply.

steps.explain: Когда клиент угрожает уйти, признайте ущерб, попросите короткое время и пообещайте конкретный результат: план восстановления с датой.

words.how: План возврата проекта в график с новой датой.
words.ex: I will bring you a recovery plan.

words.how: Деньги, которые клиент не получил из-за задержки.

words.ex: We accept accountability for our part.

steps.msg: You investigate. The causes: the client's content came two weeks late, the team lost one developer, and your plan had no buffer. Julia asks how to present it to Greg.

options.t: Present the facts without blame: three causes, our part and their part. Then focus on the plan. I'd say clearly what I should have done, such as flagging the content risk and adding a buffer.
options.c: Факты, доля вины и план.
options.r: Greg listens to the facts, and the call moves to what happens next.

options.t: Focus on the plan only. Greg is angry, and he does not want explanations now, so we show him the new dates and the actions. Greg is calling from the airport and has little time.
options.c: Нужно хотя бы коротко назвать причины.
options.r: Greg stays angry, and later asks why the delay happened at all.

options.t: Show that most delays were caused by the client's side, so that Greg understands that part of the problem is his team.
options.c: Давление фактами против клиента.
options.r: Greg replies by email with his own timeline, and the debate begins.

options.t: Tell him that the team had problems and that it is now solved. We shouldn't give him details, because they will make him more angry.
options.c: Скрывает причины.
options.r: Greg learns the real causes from his own team and trusts you less.

steps.explain: Честный разбор с признанием своей части вины и акцентом на плане восстанавливает доверие лучше, чем оправдания или молчание.

words.how: Разбор: почему на самом деле произошла проблема.
words.ex: The root cause analysis shows three causes.
Late content was a contributing factor.

words.how: Вина и действия распределены между сторонами.

steps.msg: The recovery plan needs the launch in four weeks, with the core features first. You need two extra developers for three weeks, and Julia says the agency has little margin. Greg wants a discount.

options.t: Offer a fair deal: we add two developers at our cost, because we are late. In return the client approves content on time with named people and dates, and we launch in four weeks. No discount on the contract, but a goodwill credit on the next phase.
options.c: Взаимные обязательства и умеренная уступка.
options.r: Greg agrees to name content owners, and the plan is set for four weeks.

options.t: Give Greg the discount he asks, because he is angry. We keep the client, and in the long term it's worth the money.
options.c: Платит без условий.
options.r: Greg gets the discount, and the agency loses money on the project.

options.t: Refuse the discount and say that the agency has done what the contract needs. The delay is partly his fault, and the margin is small. The contract says what the agency must do. We have done it, and the delay is partly his fault.
options.c: Жёсткий отказ вредит отношениям.
options.r: Greg becomes angrier and threatens to take the case to a lawyer.

options.t: Offer nothing, and tell Greg to wait for the new date. We can negotiate the price after the launch, when everyone is calmer.
options.c: Отодвигает вопрос денег.
options.r: Greg hears no offer and decides to talk to other agencies.

steps.explain: Хороший обмен: вы вкладываете ресурсы, клиент берёт на себя свои обязательства. Скидка без условий и жёсткий отказ одинаково слабы.

words.ex: We need named approvers with dates.

steps.msg: Three weeks later the team is on track, and Greg writes: "Good progress. But I still want a report every day." Daily reports take you an hour each. What do you do?

options.t: Thank you, Greg. I'll send a short dashboard daily with three numbers, and a short call on Mondays and Thursdays. After the launch, we move back to weekly reports. Is that okay?
options.c: Принимает форму и сохраняет время.
options.r: Greg accepts the short daily dashboard, and the calls become shorter.

options.t: Of course. I'll write the report every day and make it detailed, so Greg sees that we are open and honest.
options.c: Берёт нагрузку без границ.
options.r: Reports take you an hour each, and the team gets less of your time.

options.t: I'd say that a daily report is too much and ask for a weekly one. It takes time from the team. A weekly report is easier to read and to check.
options.c: Спорит о форме после кризиса.
options.r: Greg says he did not ask for a fight, and the call becomes tense.

options.t: I'll send reports every day, but I'll make them short and quick, so that they take me only five minutes.
options.c: Формальные отписки подорвут доверие.
options.r: Greg notices the reports are empty, and trust drops again.

steps.explain: После кризиса клиенту нужна прозрачность. Предложите короткий формат отчётов и срок, после которого вернётесь к обычному ритму.

words.ex: We agree on a reporting cadence.
After launch we scale back to weekly reports.

endings.good: The client stays and gives you a bigger project. You turned a threat into trust, and your team feels protected.
endings.mid: The project continues, but the relationship is cold, and you spend months proving yourself.
endings.bad: The client leaves, and the agency loses money and reputation. You learn how fast trust can end.

steps.msg: Hannah gives you a project from a PM who left. There is no plan, the board is full of old tasks, and the client says: "We have had three managers in six months." What do you do first?

options.t: Read the contract and the history, then talk to the team one by one, and the client for 30 minutes. In a week I'll show a plan with what is done, what is left and what is risky.
options.c: Сначала понимание, потом план.
options.r: The team shows you the board, and the client sees you took time to understand.

options.t: Start a new plan from the beginning, to be safe. I'll make a new board, and I'll tell the team to move the tasks they still need.
options.c: Выбрасывает историю.
options.r: The team loses two weeks of context, and people feel ignored.

options.t: Ask Hannah for a list of the problems and the history of the project, and wait for her answer before I start. She was on the project from the start. The list of problems will save me two days of reading the old messages.
options.c: Ждёт вместо действия.
options.r: Hannah is busy, and you lose a week of time.

options.t: Tell the client that the earlier mistakes were the last PM's fault, and that everything will be better now.
options.c: Критикует предшественника.
options.r: The client hears about the old PM and starts to doubt the agency.

steps.explain: Принимая проект, сначала изучите договор и историю и поговорите с людьми, затем покажите план. Не критикуйте предшественника.

words.how: Проверить договор, план, бюджет и статус задач.
Список людей и их влияние на проект.

steps.msg: The review shows that 12 tasks are marked "in progress" for over a month, and two features were promised to the client and never started. The client does not know.

options.t: I'd tell the client in the first meeting: two features are not started, and here is the new date. I'd call it "what I found" and not "what went wrong." Then I'd ask what matters most to them.
options.c: Открыто сообщает и спрашивает приоритеты.
options.r: The client values the early honesty, and agrees on a new date.

options.t: I'd tell the client only about the new plan, and fix the two features without making a big story from it.
options.c: Не говорит, что обещание нарушено.
options.r: The client thinks everything is fine, and later finds the two features missing.

options.t: I'd wait until the features are almost ready, and then I'd tell the client about the delay with the result in my hands. Then I can show the client a fixed date and a plan.
options.c: Скрывает до последнего.
options.r: The client finds out two weeks before the end and is upset.

options.t: I'd ask the developers to start them quietly and finish before the client asks.
options.c: Тихо надеется успеть.
options.r: The developers feel uncomfortable, and one tells the client by accident.

steps.explain: Если нашли невыполненные обещания, сообщите клиенту сами, с новой датой и вопросом о приоритетах. Скрытность разрушает доверие.

words.ex: There is a commitment gap of two features.

words.how: Честно обсудить реальные сроки и объём.

steps.msg: The team says that the old PM asked them to update the board every day, and they hated it. You want a lighter routine. What do you propose?

options.t: Let's ask the team what helps them. I'd suggest a 10-minute standup three times a week and a board update only when a task changes. We try it for two weeks and then decide together.
options.c: Спрашивает и пробует ограниченный срок.
options.r: The team picks a lighter routine, and work becomes calmer.

options.t: I'll stop the daily updates and use a weekly meeting instead. Less work for everyone, and I'll check the board myself. Daily updates take time from everyone. A weekly meeting is less work for the team.
options.c: Решает один.
options.r: The team feels you did not ask, and a small tension grows.

options.t: We keep the daily update, since it helps me control the project. People will get used to it.
options.c: Игнорирует жалобы.
options.r: The team is annoyed, and board updates are often late.

options.t: Let's not have any routine for now. The team knows what to do, and I'll ask if I need something.
options.c: Теряет видимость.
options.r: Nobody knows what is going on, and the client asks for status twice.

steps.explain: Новые ритуалы согласуйте с командой и введите как эксперимент на короткий срок: так они лучше принимаются.

endings.good: You turned a messy project into a stable one without drama. The team and the client both feel that someone finally has control.
endings.mid: The project becomes stable, but the first month was difficult, and some people are still unsure about the new plan.
endings.bad: The project stays chaotic, and the team feels that you changed the rules without listening.

steps.msg: Atlas must raise its rates by 8% next year because of higher salaries. Julia asks you to tell Greg, who hates price increases and has a procurement review next month.

options.t: Greg, our rates rise by 8% from January. I want to explain why: salaries in our market rose by 9%, and we kept the team stable and the quality high. I can offer a six-month rate lock for work that you commit to now. Could we find 30 minutes next week?
options.c: Размер, причина, ценность для клиента и вариант с фиксацией ставки.

options.t: Greg, the rates are rising by 8% from January. This is the market situation.
options.c: Факт без причины и выбора: клиент почувствует давление.

options.t: Greg, we're sorry, but we have no choice. Prices are going up.
options.c: Извинение без аргумента: слабая позиция.

options.t: Greg, we'll keep the old rates for your project, but please don't tell other clients.
options.c: Секретная скидка создаёт проблемы с другими клиентами.

words.ex: The new rate card starts in January.
We offer a six-month rate lock.

words.how: Регулярная проверка поставщиков отделом закупок клиента.
words.ex: Greg has a procurement review next month.

steps.msg: Dan, a junior PM, tells you: 'I sent the client a plan with the wrong dates. She noticed. I feel stupid.' He asks what to do now.

options.t: Everyone does this once. First, write to the client today: 'Sorry, here is the corrected plan, the mistake was ours.' Then let's find the cause: was it a copy-paste, an old version, or a missing check? A pre-send checklist will prevent it. I'll review the next two plans with you.
options.c: Нормализует ошибку, называет шаги к клиенту, ищет причину и вводит чек-лист.

options.t: Don't worry about it. The client will forget in a week.
options.c: Умаляет проблему: Дэн не научится и не исправит процесс.

options.t: You should have double-checked. Be more careful next time.
options.c: Нотация без помощи: Дэн почувствует себя ещё хуже.

options.t: Let me write to the client for you, so you don't have to.
options.c: Делает за него: он не вырастет.

words.ex: Add a quality gate before sending.

words.how: Новая версия документа с исправленной ошибкой.
Атмосфера, где можно признавать ошибки без наказания.
words.ex: Psychological safety helps people report mistakes.

steps.msg: A new client wants a full online shop in six weeks. Your team's estimate is 14 weeks. Julia says: 'Can we make it six? They'll go to another agency.'

options.t: Not the full shop. In six weeks we can launch a first release with catalog, cart and payment. The rest follows in two more releases. I'd show the client the roadmap and what they get at each date, so we win on clarity, not on a promise we can't keep.
options.c: Предлагает первый релиз за шесть недель, остальное поэтапно: честно и продающе.

options.t: Yes, if the team works overtime and we skip some testing.
options.c: Сокращение тестов и переработки: риск провала запуска.

options.t: No. The estimate is 14 weeks, and I can't change it.
options.c: Жёсткое нет без альтернативы: теряете сделку.

options.t: Let's say yes, and discuss the problems later with the client.
options.c: Обещание, которое нельзя выполнить: конфликт гарантирован.

words.how: Разбивка проекта на выпуски с составом и датой.
words.ex: The release plan has three releases.
Payment is on the critical path.

words.how: Сократить срок добавлением ресурсов или уменьшением объёма.
words.ex: We can compress the schedule only by reducing scope.

steps.msg: Paul shows that your project's margin is 12%, while the agency target is 25%. He asks what you will do for the rest of the project.

options.t: I see three sources: extra design rounds, a fixed-price task that grew, and idle time between phases. For the rest, I'll limit revisions, send two change requests I had held back, and move one designer to another project when the work finishes. I'll send you a forecast by Friday.
options.c: Причины, конкретные меры и срок прогноза: управление маржой, а не надежда.

options.t: I'll ask the team to work faster. That should improve the margin.
options.c: Давление на скорость снизит качество и не решит структуру затрат.

options.t: I'll ask Julia to raise the price for the rest of the project.
options.c: Цена в договоре уже согласована.

options.t: The margin is low because the client is difficult. Nothing can be done.
options.c: Отказ управлять результатом.

words.how: Доля оплачиваемых часов от рабочего времени.
Ожидаемая итоговая стоимость или маржа проекта.
words.ex: I'll send the forecast at completion.

steps.msg: The client's CEO writes to your CEO: 'My team says Atlas is slow and unclear.' Julia asks you to prepare facts within one hour. You are the project manager.

options.t: In one hour I'll send one page: plan versus actual, delays and their causes, what we have changed, and next steps. I'll also add, in neutral words, what we're waiting for from their side. I'd like us to answer with facts and an offer for a call, not a defense.
options.c: Короткий отчёт: план против факта, причины, меры, ожидания от клиента.

options.t: I'll write that the client's team has delayed us many times.
options.c: Обвинение звучит как оборона.

options.t: I'll write a long report with all emails, so everything is documented.
options.c: Сотня писем не помогает руководителю читать.

options.t: Let's ignore the message. The CEO is not part of the project.
options.c: Игнорирование — сигнал, что клиента не слышат.

words.how: Передача проблемы на более высокий уровень.
words.ex: The client escalated to our CEO.

words.how: Подтверждённые данные и документы для разговора.
Руководитель, который отвечает за проект и ресурсы.
words.ex: The CEO is the executive sponsor.

steps.msg: Two of your projects need the same design system update. If you do it for one, the other will be late. Both clients are important.

options.t: I'd do it once for both, a week earlier than planned. I'll ask both clients to approve the shared components first, adjust the later tasks, and put the update in both plans as a shared dependency. If someone must wait, I'll tell them first with a date.
options.c: Один общий компонент, согласованный с обоими клиентами: экономия и честность.

options.t: I'll do it for the bigger client first, and the other will wait.
options.c: Приоритет по размеру клиента без анализа вредит отношениям.

options.t: I'll build two separate updates, one for each project.
options.c: Дублирование: двойная стоимость и несовместимость.

options.t: I'll ask Hannah to decide which project is more important.
options.c: Перекладывание решения вместо предложения.

words.how: Задача, от которой зависят несколько проектов.
words.ex: The design system is a shared dependency.

words.how: Элемент, который можно применять в нескольких местах.

steps.msg: Greg's lawyer wants a clause: 'The agency pays 1% per day for each day of delay, without limit.' Julia asks your opinion.

options.t: I'd accept a penalty, but with a cap at 10% and only for delays caused by us. Delays from the client's side, such as late approvals or content, extend the deadline automatically. Without these two points, one slow approval could cost us more than the project margin.
options.c: Принять штраф, но с лимитом и только за свои задержки: честный баланс.

options.t: I'd refuse any penalty. It's too risky for an agency.
options.c: Полный отказ закроет договор.

options.t: I'd accept it as it is. We never delay anyway.
options.c: Неограниченный штраф без защиты: серьёзный финансовый риск.

options.t: I'd accept it, and then we'll never sign a new contract with this client.
options.c: Не ведёт к решению: клиент получит то, что хочет.

words.how: Заранее оговорённая сумма штрафа за нарушение срока.
Задержка по вине клиента или форс-мажора, освобождающая от штрафа.

steps.msg: Hannah asks you to forecast the team's capacity for next quarter. You have three projects, one new client, and two people on vacation in August.

options.t: I'll make a table by week: available hours per person, minus holidays and meetings, versus planned work. I'll mark weeks where we're above 90% utilization. I'll send the first version on Thursday, and I'd like to review the assumptions with you before Friday.
options.c: Таблица по неделям с вычетом отпусков и встреч, пометки перегрузки и проверка допущений.

options.t: I'll estimate it from last quarter. It was similar.
options.c: Прошлый квартал не учитывает новый проект и отпуска.

options.t: I'll ask each person how busy they will be.
options.c: Ответы людей без расчёта: субъективно и неполно.

options.t: I'll tell you now that we're full, and we shouldn't accept the new client.
options.c: Вывод без расчёта.

words.how: Кто, когда и на что назначен.
words.ex: The resource plan shows an overload.

steps.msg: A freelance developer on your project misses two deadlines in a row. He says: 'Sorry, I had personal problems.' The critical feature is his, and the launch is in three weeks.

options.t: I'm sorry about your situation. Let's talk about what you can realistically do. I need a clear plan this week: what you'll finish, by when, and a check every two days. If you can't finish it, tell me now, so I can arrange cover. I'll keep the details between us.
options.c: Эмпатия, реалистичный план, короткие проверки и запасной вариант: ответственность сохраняется.

options.t: Please just finish the feature on time. Personal problems can't affect the project.
options.c: Жёстко и без плана: человек замкнётся.

options.t: No problem, take your time. We'll wait for you.
options.c: Снимает срок при критической функции: риск запуска.

options.t: I'll ask the agency to find another freelancer, and I won't tell you.
options.c: Скрытая замена нечестна и подрывает доверие.

words.ex: The freelancer owns the payment module.

words.how: Ситуация, когда всё зависит от одного человека.
words.ex: He is a single point of failure.

words.how: План действий на случай, если риск реализуется.
words.ex: We need a contingency plan for his feature.

steps.msg: Your agency lost an important pitch. Julia asks for a quick analysis. You think the price was too high and the proposal too long.

options.t: I reviewed it with the team. Three points: our price was 20% above the winner, the proposal had 40 pages, and we had no case study in their industry. Next time: a short proposal of ten pages, a case from a similar client, and a pricing option with a smaller first phase. I'll also ask the client for feedback.
options.c: Конкретные причины, сравнение с победителем и план улучшений плюс запрос обратной связи.

options.t: We lost because the client chose the cheapest agency. It's not about us.
options.c: Объясняет цену, но не учит ничему.

options.t: We lost because the other agency had better sales people.
options.c: Необоснованное предположение.

options.t: I don't know. We did everything we could.
options.c: Отказ анализировать: те же ошибки в следующем питче.

words.how: Разбор причин победы или поражения в сделке.

words.ex: We had no case study in their industry.

steps.msg: You are overloaded with five projects. Hannah says you must give two to Dan, a junior PM. You are afraid that he will make mistakes.

options.t: Dan, I'd like you to take over two smaller projects. I'll show you the contracts, plans and key contacts, and we meet twice a week for the first month. You decide the small things, and we agree on the big ones.
options.c: Передача с поддержкой и границами.

options.t: Dan, you can take two projects. I'll send you the files, and please ask me if you have any questions. I'm sure you will do well.
options.c: Передача без структуры.

options.t: Dan, I'll give you the two projects, but please copy me on all emails to clients, and tell me about every decision before you make it. You have not managed two projects before. I want to avoid surprises for the clients.
options.c: Контроль без доверия.

options.t: Dan, I think it's too early for you to manage whole projects. Maybe I'll give you a few tasks, and you can learn on small things.
options.c: Обесценивает Дэна.

words.how: Передача задач и решений другому человеку.
Договор, план, контакты и история проекта.

steps.msg: After two weeks Dan makes a decision without asking: he promises the client a new feature at no cost. It's a big decision for a small gain. You find out from the client.

options.t: Dan, I heard about the free feature from the client. Let's talk it through. What was your thinking? Then let's agree what you decide alone: up to two hours of work, and above that we talk. I'll call the client with you today.
options.c: Выясняет логику и определяет границы.

options.t: Dan, you should have asked me. Now we must keep the promise to the client, but next time please tell me before you decide.
options.c: Принимает последствия без правил.

options.t: I'll write to the client and say that the offer was a mistake, and that we can't do it for free. Dan will learn from this.
options.c: Подрывает Дэна перед клиентом.

options.t: I'll take the projects back. Dan is not ready yet, and I can't take risks like this. The clients know Dan less than me. It is easier to calm them down myself. Dan can learn from the next small project.
options.c: Забирает передачу.

words.ex: Set an authority limit of two hours.

words.how: Решение, которое станет примером для будущего.
words.ex: A free feature sets a precedent.

words.how: Разговор для развития, а не для наказания.

steps.msg: The client's CEO asks you directly in a call: "Can you launch one month earlier? There is a big event in March." You were planning April. The team is in the same call.

options.t: I can't say yes right away, and I don't want to promise something we can't do. Give me one day. I'll check with the team what we could launch by March, and I'll come back with options.
options.c: Не обещает, берёт день и обещает варианты.

options.t: That's an interesting request. We're a bit tight, but I'll see what we can do. I'll send you an update soon.
options.c: Звучит как согласие.

options.t: Yes, we can. The team can work harder in the next months, and we will find a way to launch earlier. I have already seen the plan, and the dates are not impossible. I'd tell the client today.
options.c: Обещает при команде без проверки.

options.t: No, it's impossible. April was agreed in the contract, and we can't change it now.
options.c: Категоричный отказ.

words.ex: We cannot accelerate without a plan.
Give me a day for the feasibility check.

words.how: Выигрыш в одном за счёт другого.

steps.msg: After the call your team finds that a version with the core features can be ready by early March, but it needs two more developers for six weeks and has more risk. You call the CEO back.

options.t: For March, we can launch the core features: catalog, checkout and login. That needs two more developers for six weeks, which costs about 18,000, and the risk is medium. The full scope stays in April. Do you want us to go ahead?
options.c: Состав, цена, риск и решение клиенту.

options.t: We can do an early launch in March with fewer features. It would cost more, but I think it's worth it for the event. I'll send you the plan tomorrow.
options.c: Нет цифр.

options.t: Good news: we can launch in March. The team found a way. The details we will clarify in the next days, and I'll send you a plan. The client likes to hear good news early. I'll write to her tonight.
options.c: Хорошая новость без цены.

options.t: We checked it and it's really too risky. I suggest we keep April, and you can use a preview of the site at the event.
options.c: Отказывает, не показав вариант.

words.how: Решение клиента, что работа может идти.
words.ex: We need your go-ahead by Friday.

steps.msg: Julia gives you a project that is 10 weeks late and 40% over budget. The client threatens to end the contract. The team says: "Nobody knows what the plan is." What is your first week plan?

options.t: Three steps: first a day with the team to see where we really are, then a call with the client to listen, and by Friday a new plan with scope, dates and costs. Until then, no new promises.
options.c: План на неделю с шагами и без обещаний.
options.r: Julia agrees, and the team gets a clear week with no new promises.

options.t: I'd call the client first, apologize, and promise that the project will be finished in six weeks. They need to hear something positive.
options.c: Обещает дату без анализа.
options.r: The client hears a date without a plan, and trust breaks again at week three.

options.t: I'd ask for another PM or more budget before I start. The project is in a bad state, and I can't fix it alone. It would be good to have a fresh view on the project.
options.c: Просит ресурсы вместо анализа.
options.r: Julia says there is no spare PM, and you lose several days.

options.t: I'd tell the team to work harder and to give me a list of what is left. Then I'd take the list to the client.
options.c: Только давит на команду.
options.r: The team works late, and the list the client gets is not realistic.

steps.explain: Для проблемного проекта сначала разберитесь, где вы на самом деле, выслушайте клиента и дайте новый план. Не обещайте новых дат заранее.

words.how: Действия по выводу проекта из кризиса.
Встреча, на которой клиенту дают высказаться.

steps.msg: The team review shows that 35% of the remaining work is changes that the client asked for verbally, never priced, and the requirements are unclear. How do you present this to the client?

options.t: I'd show the client the list: 20 verbal requests with estimates, and the original scope. I'd say, "These changes are valuable, and they explain the delay. Let's choose which to keep and agree on a price and date."
options.c: Показывает список и ведёт к решению.
options.r: The client sees the list, accepts the costs, and the talk turns to choices.

options.t: I'd tell the client that the delay is partly because of their changes, and ask them to stop adding more requests, so that we can finish. The last three requests came from her side. I'd write it in a friendly way.
options.c: Обвиняет клиента.
options.r: The client is offended and says changes are part of the work.

options.t: I'd not mention the verbal requests. The client may get angry, and it's better to speak about the new plan and not about the past.
options.c: Скрывает причину.
options.r: The client finds the unpriced changes later and feels cheated.

options.t: I'd send a formal letter that lists all the requests and says we will charge for each of them. The client needs to know the rules.
options.c: Холодный тон.
options.r: The client replies coldly, and the call is full of legal words.

steps.explain: Устные просьбы без цены — частая причина проблем. Покажите список и оценки без обвинений и предложите выбрать, что оставить.

words.how: Работа, о стоимости которой не договорились.
words.ex: There is a lot of unpriced work.

steps.msg: The client agrees to keep 12 of the 20 requests and pay for them, but wants the launch in eight weeks. Your plan says ten weeks with the current team. You have one chance to propose.

options.t: Eight weeks is possible with two extra developers and a release in two parts: the main part in week eight, and the rest in week ten. I'd need the client to name one decision-maker who answers within 24 hours.
options.c: Условия, два этапа и один ответственный клиент.
options.r: The client names one decision-maker, and agrees to two releases.

options.t: We can try eight weeks if the client approves quickly. If there are delays on the client side, we'll move the date. The first week is for the client's brief and the plan. Each week of delay on her side moves our launch.
options.c: Много «если» без обязательств.
options.r: The client agrees but later delays an approval, and the plan slips.

options.t: Ten weeks is the realistic date. I'd ask the client to accept it, because trying to go faster caused the problems at the start.
options.c: Прав, но не решает.
options.r: The client feels you refuse the date and asks Julia to step in.

options.t: Okay, let's do eight weeks. The client has paid, and we need to show we want to help them. We'll work extra hours.
options.c: Принимает без плана.
options.r: The team works extra hours, and quality drops in week five.

steps.explain: Если срок короче реального, предложите этапы и условия: ресурсы, один ответственный со стороны клиента и быстрые решения.

words.how: Разбивка на основной и дополнительный выпуск.
Кто на стороне клиента может утверждать.

words.ex: We ramp up with two developers.

steps.msg: In week six the team is on track, but two developers say they are exhausted, and one asks to leave the project after the launch. What do you do?

options.t: I'd talk to both today. I'd give each a day off this week, cut one low-priority task, and agree on a rest after the launch. I'd also say thanks in the team call, and tell Julia about the load.
options.c: Забота, снижение нагрузки и признание.
options.r: Both developers feel heard, and the launch plan keeps its date.

options.t: I'd tell them to hold on for two more weeks, because we are almost there, and after the launch they can have a vacation.
options.c: Откладывает усталость.
options.r: They work through, but one still leaves after the launch.

options.t: I'd ask Julia to give them a bonus. Money helps, and they will feel more motivated to finish the project.
options.c: Только деньги.
